# BH00008 (Unnamed)

*Translated on 17 Qudrat 183 using GPT 6.1 Sol*

### 1

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسم ربّنا الأقدس الأعظم الأبهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismi Rabbinā al-Aqdas al-Aʿẓam al-Abhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of our Lord, the Most Holy, the Most Great, the All-Glorious.
:::

### 2

::: {.original lang="ar"}
الحمد للّه الّذی وفی بالوعد و انزل الموعود من سمآء مشیّته و اظهر ما کان مسطوراً من قلمه الأعلی فی کتبه و صحفه و زبره و الواحه قد قام القیام و اتت السّاعة و ظهر الصّراط و سرت نسمة اللّه و فاح عرف قمیصه رغماً لملأ البیان الّذین نقضوا میثاق اللّه و عهده و ارادوا ان تعمروا بیوت الظّنون و الأوهام بأیادی الظّلم و الاعتساف کما عمّروها من قبل تبّاً لهم و سحقاً لهم و بعداً لهم یا ملأ الأوهام قد انار الأفق الأعلی و ظهر ما تستره حجبات انفسکم و لا اوهامکم انّه قد ظهر بسلطان من عنده و خرق السّبحات و الحجبات بأصابع القدرة علی شأن سمع الملأ الأعلی صوت خرقها اتّقوا اللّه یا معشر الغافلین لا تصدّوا النّاس عن السّبیل و لا تمنعوهم عن الدّلیل هذا یوم فیه ماج بحر العلم و هاج عرف اللّه المهیمن القیّوم خافوا اللّه و لا تدحضوا الحقّ بأقوالکم و افعالکم انّ الخادم ینصحکم لوجه اللّه یشهد بذلک کلّ منصف بصیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Al-ḥamdu li-llāh alladhī wafā bi-l-waʿd wa-anzala al-Mawʿūd min samāʾ mashīʾatihi wa-aẓhara mā kāna masṭūran min qalamihi al-aʿlā fī kutubihi wa-ṣuḥufihi wa-zuburihi wa-alwāḥihi. Qad qāma al-qiyām wa-atati al-sāʿa wa-ẓahara al-ṣirāṭ wa-sarat nasmatu Allāh wa-fāḥa ʿarfu qamīṣihi raghman li-malaʾ al-Bayān alladhīna naqaḍū mīthāqa Allāh wa-ʿahdahu wa-arādū an taʿmurū buyūta al-ẓunūn wa-l-awhām bi-aydī al-ẓulm wa-l-iʿtisāf kamā ʿammarūhā min qabl. Tabban lahum wa-suḥqan lahum wa-buʿdan lahum. Yā malaʾ al-awhām, qad anāra al-ufuq al-aʿlā wa-ẓahara mā tasturuhu ḥujubātu anfusikum wa-lā awhāmukum. Innahu qad ẓahara bi-sulṭānin min ʿindihi wa-kharaqa al-subuḥāt wa-l-ḥujubāt bi-aṣābiʿ al-qudra ʿalā shaʾnin samiʿa al-malaʾ al-aʿlā ṣawta kharqihā. Ittaqū Allāh yā maʿshar al-ghāfilīn. Lā taṣuddū al-nāsa ʿan al-sabīl wa-lā tamnaʿūhum ʿan al-dalīl. Hādhā yawmun fīhi māja baḥru al-ʿilm wa-hāja ʿarfu Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Khāfū Allāh wa-lā tudḥiḍū al-ḥaqqa bi-aqwālikum wa-afʿālikum. Inna al-khādima yanṣaḥukum li-wajhi Allāh, yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu munṣifin baṣīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to God, who has fulfilled the promise, sent down the Promised One from the heaven of His will, and revealed what was inscribed by His Most Exalted Pen in His books, scriptures, writings, and tablets. The Resurrection has arisen, the Hour has come, the Path has appeared, the breeze of God has blown, and the fragrance of His garment has spread, despite the people of the Bayán, who have broken God’s covenant and pledge and have desired that you build the houses of conjecture and delusion with the hands of oppression and tyranny, as they built them before. Perish they; may they be crushed and banished! People of delusion! The Most Exalted Horizon has shone forth, and there has appeared what neither the veils of your own selves nor your delusions conceal. He has appeared with a sovereignty of His own and has torn through the veils of glory and concealment with the fingers of power, so that the Concourse on high has heard the sound of their rending. Fear God, you who are heedless! Do not turn people away from the path or keep them from the Guide. This is a day on which the ocean of knowledge has surged and the fragrance of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, has spread. Fear God, and do not seek to refute the truth through your words and deeds. This servant counsels you for the sake of God; every fair-minded, discerning person bears witness to this.
:::

### 3

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و الصّلوة و السّلام و التّکبیر و البهآء علی الّذین شربوا رحیق الاستقامة و قاموا علی خدمة الأمر بالحکمة و البیان و شهدوا بما شهد به لسان العظمة قبل خلق الأشیآء اولئک عباد وصفهم اللّه فی الفرقان و فی البیان طوبی لذی اذن سمع و لذی بصر رأی و ویل لکلّ خادع مکّار الّذی اتّخذ الوهم لنفسه ربّا من دون اللّه و یمنع النّاس عن فرات رحمة ربّهم الغفور الکریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-l-ṣalātu wa-l-salāmu wa-l-takbīru wa-l-bahāʾ ʿalā alladhīna sharibū raḥīqa al-istiqāma wa-qāmū ʿalā khidmati al-amr bi-l-ḥikma wa-l-bayān wa-shahidū bi-mā shahida bihi lisānu al-ʿaẓama qabla khalqi al-ashyāʾ. Ulāʾika ʿibādun waṣafahumu Allāh fī al-Furqān wa-fī al-Bayān. Ṭūbā li-dhī udhunin samiʿa wa-li-dhī baṣarin raʾā, wa-waylun li-kulli khādiʿin makkār alladhī ittakhadha al-wahma li-nafsihi rabban min dūni Allāh wa-yamnaʿu al-nāsa ʿan furāti raḥmati rabbihim al-Ghafūr al-Karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
And blessings, peace, exaltation, and glory be upon those who have drunk the choice wine of steadfastness, arisen to serve the Cause with wisdom and eloquence, and testified to what the Tongue of Grandeur testified before the creation of all things. These are servants whom God has described in the Qur’an and in the Bayán. Blessed is the one with an ear who has heard, and the one with sight who has seen; and woe to every scheming deceiver who has taken delusion as his lord instead of God and keeps people from the sweet waters of the mercy of their Lord, the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.
:::

### 4

::: {.original lang="ar"}
عرض میشود نامهٴ آنجناب باین خادم فانی رسید بعد از قرائت و اطّلاع قصد مقام مالک ابداع نموده تلقاء وجه حاضر و بعد از اذن آنچه در نامه بود بشرف اصغا فائز گشت و اینکلمات عالیات از سماء عنایت منزل آیات نازل قوله جلّ جلاله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
ʿArż mī-shavad nāmih-yi ān-janāb bi-īn khādim-i fānī rasīd. Baʿd az qirāʾat va iṭṭilāʿ, qaṣd-i maqām-i Mālik-i Ibdāʿ namūdih, tilqāʾ-i vajh ḥāżir va baʿd az idhn ānchih dar nāmih būd bi-sharaf-i iṣghā fāʾiz gasht, va īn kalimāt-i ʿāliyāt az samā-yi ʿināyat-i Munzil-i Āyāt nāzil. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
I respectfully submit that your letter reached this transient servant. After reading it and learning its contents, I proceeded to the abode of the Lord of Creation and entered His presence. After permission was granted, the contents of the letter were honored with His hearing, and these exalted words descended from the heaven of the grace of the Revealer of Verses. His words—exalted be His glory:
:::

### 5

::: {.original lang="ar"}
انا المظلوم الغریب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Anā al-Maẓlūm al-Gharīb.
:::

::: {.translation}
I am the Wronged One, the Stranger.
:::

### 6

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ایّها النّاظر الی الوجه نامه‌ات نزد مظلوم حاضر و عبد حاضر تمام آنرا عرض نمود للّه الحمد رحیق عرفان را نوشیدی و بافق رحمن توجّه نمودی در ایّامیکه افئده و قلوب از ظلم مشرکین مضطرب و ارکان بیت از اعتساف علما متزلزل در اوّل هر ظهور از مظهر الهی و مشرق وحی ربّانی اعراض نمودند و فتوی بر سفک دماء آن نفوس مقدّسه دادند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ayyuhā al-nāẓir ilā al-wajh, nāmih-at nazd-i Maẓlūm ḥāżir va ʿabd-i ḥāżir tamām-i ān-rā ʿarż namūd. Li-llāh al-ḥamd, raḥīq-i ʿirfān-rā nūshīdī va bi-ufuq-i Raḥmān tavajjuh namūdī dar ayyāmī kih afʾidih va qulūb az ẓulm-i mushrikīn mużṭarib va arkān-i bayt az iʿtisāf-i ʿulamā mutazalzil. Dar avval-i har ẓuhūr az Maẓhar-i Ilāhī va Mashriq-i Vaḥy-i Rabbānī iʿrāż namūdand va fatvā bar safk-i dimā-yi ān nufūs-i muqaddasih dādand.
:::

::: {.translation}
You who gaze toward the Face! Your letter is before the Wronged One, and the servant in attendance has presented it in full. Praise be to God, you have drunk the choice wine of recognition and turned toward the horizon of the All-Merciful in days when hearts and souls are agitated by the oppression of those who associate partners with God, and the pillars of the House are shaken by the tyranny of the religious scholars. At the beginning of every revelation, they turned away from the Manifestation of God and the Dawning-Place of divine revelation, and issued decrees for the shedding of the blood of those holy souls.
:::

### 7

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هجرت خاتم انبیا روح ما سواه فداه از مکّه سبب که بود و علّت چه و صعود حضرت روح بفلک چهارم از دست که بقسمی بر آنحضرت سخت شد که ید قدرت او را صعود داد و بفلک چهارمش برد به عمامه و ردایات حقّ را بکمال ظلم و اعتساف بستند و باب عزّت و ثروت باسم آنحضرت از برای خود گشودند اگر نفوس مطمئنّه در امورات قبل تفکّر کنند لعمراللّه بمثابهٴ فاقدین بر مظلوم عالم نوحه و ندبه نمایند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Hijrat-i Khātam-i Anbiyā, rūḥ-i mā sivāh fidāh, az Makkih sabab kih būd va ʿillat chih, va ṣuʿūd-i Ḥaẓrat-i Rūḥ bi-falak-i chahārum az dast-i kih? Bi-qismī bar ān Ḥaẓrat sakht shud kih yad-i qudrat ū-rā ṣuʿūd dād va bi-falak-i chahārumash burd. Bih ʿamāmih va ridāyāt Ḥaqq-rā bi-kamāl-i ẓulm va iʿtisāf bastand va bāb-i ʿizzat va thirvat bi-ism-i ān Ḥaẓrat az barā-yi khud gushūdand. Agar nufūs-i muṭmaʾinnih dar umūrāt-i qabl tafakkur kunand, la-ʿamru Allāh, bi-mathābih-yi fāqidīn bar Maẓlūm-i ʿālam nawḥih va nudbih namāyand.
:::

::: {.translation}
Who brought about the departure of the Seal of the Prophets—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—from Mecca, and what was its cause? And at whose hands did the Spirit ascend to the fourth heaven? He was so sorely afflicted that the hand of power raised Him up and carried Him to the fourth heaven. With turbans and robes they bound the True One with the utmost oppression and tyranny, and in His name opened for themselves the door to honor and wealth. If assured souls reflect on the events of the past, by the life of God, they will lament and weep over the Wronged One of the world like those bereaved.
:::

### 8

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هنگام حرکت از زوراء کلّ را اخبار نمودیم بارتفاع نعاق در آفاق جمیع از خوف و اضطراب خلف حجاب ساکن و حقّ وحده بر امر قیام نمود و چون اشراقات انوار آفتاب توحید پرتو افکند و عالم فی الجمله روشن و منیر گشت از خلف حجاب بیرون آمده اوّل بر نفس حقّ اعتراض نمودند و بسیوف اعراض بر سفک دم مطهّرش قیام کردند اینست شأن ناس ان اعتبروا یا اولی الألباب یا ایّها المشتعل بنار محبّة اللّه حمد کن محبوب عالم را که بنعمت باقیهٴ دائمه فائز شدی و آن ذکریست که از قلم اعلی در باره تو جاری شد آنچه دیده میشود البتّه او را فنا اخذ نماید مگر کلمه‌ئی که حقّ جلّ جلاله بآن تکلّم فرماید از حقّ بطلب ترا مؤیّد نماید بر آنچه که سزاوار یوم اوست معادله نمینماید بکلمهٴ او خزائن ارض و دفائن آن ان اشکر و قل لک الحمد یا من ذکرتنی و لک الثّنآء یا من بیدک زمام ملکوت ملک السّموات و الأرضین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Hingām-i ḥarakat az Zawrā kull-rā ikhbār namūdīm bi-irtifāʿ-i nuʿāq dar āfāq. Jamīʿ az khawf va iẓṭirāb khalf-i ḥijāb sākin va Ḥaqq vaḥdahu bar amr qiyām namūd, va chūn ishrāqāt-i anvār-i āftāb-i tawḥīd partaw afkand va ʿālam fī al-jumlih rawshan va munīr gasht, az khalf-i ḥijāb bīrūn āmadih avval bar nafs-i Ḥaqq iʿtirāż namūdand va bi-suyūf-i iʿrāż bar safk-i dam-i muṭahharash qiyām kardand. Īnast shaʾn-i nās. An iʿtabirū yā ulī al-albāb. Yā ayyuhā al-mushtaʿil bi-nāri maḥabbati Allāh, ḥamd kun Maḥbūb-i ʿālam-rā kih bi-niʿmat-i bāqiyih-yi dāʾimih fāʾiz shudī, va ān dhikrīst kih az Qalam-i Aʿlā dar bārih-yi tu jārī shud. Ānchih dīdih mī-shavad al-battih ū-rā fanā akhdh namāyad magar kalimih-ī kih Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu bi-ān takallum farmāyad. Az Ḥaqq bi-ṭalab tu-rā muʾayyad namāyad bar ānchih kih sazāvār-i yawm-i ūst. Muʿādilih na-mī-namāyad bi-kalimih-yi ū khazāʾin-i arż va dafāʾin-i ān. An ishkur wa-qul: Laka al-ḥamdu yā man dhakartanī, wa-laka al-thanāʾu yā man bi-yadika zimāmu malakūti mulki al-samāwāti wa-l-araḍīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
At the time of Our departure from Zawrá, We informed everyone that clamor would rise throughout the world. All remained behind the veil in fear and agitation, while the True One alone arose for the Cause. When the radiance of the light of the sun of divine unity shone forth and the world became somewhat bright and illumined, they emerged from behind the veil and first objected to the True One Himself, and arose with the swords of rejection to shed His pure blood. Such is the way of the people. Take heed, you who possess understanding! You who are aflame with the fire of the love of God! Praise the Beloved of the world, for you have attained an abiding, everlasting blessing: the mention of you that has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen. Whatever is seen will assuredly perish, except a word uttered by the True One, exalted be His glory. Ask God to confirm you in what befits His Day. The treasuries of the earth and its buried riches cannot equal a single word of His. Give thanks and say: “Praise be to You, You who have remembered me; and all acclaim be to You, in whose hand are the reins of the kingdom of dominion over the heavens and the earth.” Here ends the quotation.
:::

### 9

::: {.original lang="fa"}
دیگر خادم چه عرض نماید حقّ شاهد و گواهست که ارکانش متزلزل و قلبش مضطرب چه که دیده میشود بعضی از عباد جاهل که خود را عالم فرض گرفته‌اند در جمیع قرون و اعصار بر مطالع نور احدیّه اعتراض نموده‌اند و بکمال عناد در اطفاء نور الهی ساعی و جاهد بوده‌اند و بعد که امر مرتفع میشد بدو دست اخذ مینمودند و باسباب زهد زمام عباد را بتصرّف میآوردند چنانچه دیده و شنیده‌اید و لهم الأشباه و الأمثال فی هذه الأیّام نفوسیکه ابداً اطّلاع از این امر نداشته حال به ظلم و اعتساف قیام کرده‌اند و دعوی اطّلاع کامل نموده‌اند و نفوس ضعیفه را از شریعهٴ ربّانیّه منع مینمایند و بغدیر منتنه ترغیب و تحریض میکنند حقّ عباد را حفظ فرماید و از وساوس آن نفوس محفوظ دارد یعنی منافقین از اهل بیان اعاذنا اللّه و ایّاکم یا معشر الموحّدین من شرّ هؤلآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dīgar khādim chih ʿarż namāyad? Ḥaqq shāhid va guvāh ast kih arkānash mutazalzil va qalbash mużṭarib, chih kih dīdih mī-shavad baʿżī az ʿibād-i jāhil kih khud-rā ʿālim farż giriftih-and dar jamīʿ-i qurūn va aʿṣār bar maṭāliʿ-i nūr-i aḥadiyyih iʿtirāż namūdih-and va bi-kamāl-i ʿinād dar iṭfā-yi nūr-i ilāhī sāʿī va jāhid būdih-and, va baʿd kih amr murtafiʿ mī-shud bi-du dast akhdh mī-namūdand va bi-asbāb-i zuhd zimām-i ʿibād-rā bi-taṣarruf mī-āvardand, chinānchih dīdih va shinīdih-īd. Wa-lahumu al-ashbāhu wa-l-amthālu fī hādhihi al-ayyām. Nufūsī kih abadan iṭṭilāʿ az īn amr nadāshtih ḥāl bih ẓulm va iʿtisāf qiyām kardih-and va daʿvā-yi iṭṭilāʿ-i kāmil namūdih-and va nufūs-i żaʿīfih-rā az sharīʿih-yi rabbāniyyih manʿ mī-namāyand va bi-ghadīr-i muntinih targhīb va taḥrīṣ mī-kunand. Ḥaqq ʿibād-rā ḥifẓ farmāyad va az vasāvis-i ān nufūs maḥfūẓ dārad, yaʿnī munāfiqīn az ahl-i Bayān. Aʿādhanā Allāhu wa-iyyākum yā maʿshar al-muwaḥḥidīn min sharri hāʾulāʾ.
:::

::: {.translation}
What more can this servant say? God bears witness that his limbs are trembling and his heart is troubled, for it is evident that in every age and century certain ignorant servants, imagining themselves learned, have objected to the Dawning-Places of the light of divine unity and have striven with the utmost obstinacy to extinguish the divine light. Then, when the Cause became exalted, they would seize it with both hands and, by means of asceticism, take hold of the reins of the people, as you have seen and heard. They have their counterparts and their like in these days. Souls who had no knowledge whatever of this Cause have now arisen in oppression and tyranny, have claimed complete knowledge, and are keeping weak souls from the divine waterside, urging and encouraging them toward a stagnant, foul-smelling pool. May God protect His servants and preserve them from the whisperings of those souls, namely, the hypocrites among the people of the Bayán. May God shelter us and you, believers in His unity, from their evil.
:::

### 10

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این خادم فانی از حقّ جلّ جلاله سائل و آمل که اولیای خود را مؤیّد فرماید تا از بحر معانی کلمات الهی بیاشامند و از نار مشتعلهٴ در آن بشأنی مشتعل گردند که همزات شیاطین ایشانرا از مالک یوم الدّین منع ننماید در کاف و را نعیق مرتفع و مطلع ظنون و نفاق بکمال مکر و حیله و کلمات جعلیّه نفوس ضعیفه را از مالک احدیّه منع نموده و بناحیهٴ کذبه دعوت مینماید مع آنکه ابداً از این امر اطّلاع نداشته و ندارد محض هوی از مالک اسماء اعتراض جسته و در تیه اوهام سرگردان از حقّ میطلبم او را هدایت نماید و از رحیق معانی و سلسبیل راستی محروم نسازد و از دریای آگاهی قسمت عطا فرماید اوست بر هر شیء قادر و توانا
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn khādim-i fānī az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu sāʾil va āmil kih awliyā-yi khud-rā muʾayyad farmāyad tā az baḥr-i maʿānī-yi kalimāt-i ilāhī biyāshāmand va az nār-i mushtaʿilih-yi dar ān bi-shaʾnī mushtaʿil gardand kih hamazāt-i shayāṭīn īshān-rā az Mālik-i Yawm-i Dīn manʿ na-namāyad. Dar Kāf va Rā naʿīq murtafiʿ va maṭlaʿ-i ẓunūn va nifāq bi-kamāl-i makr va ḥīlih va kalimāt-i jaʿliyyih nufūs-i żaʿīfih-rā az Mālik-i Aḥadiyyih manʿ namūdih va bi-nāḥiyih-yi kadhabih daʿvat mī-namāyad, maʿa ānkih abadan az īn amr iṭṭilāʿ nadāshtih va na-dārad. Maḥż-i havā az Mālik-i Asmā iʿtirāż justih va dar tīh-i awhām sargardān. Az Ḥaqq mī-ṭalabam ū-rā hidāyat namāyad va az raḥīq-i maʿānī va salsabīl-i rāstī maḥrūm na-sāzad va az daryā-yi āgāhī qismat ʿaṭā farmāyad. Ūst bar har shayʾ qādir va tavānā.
:::

::: {.translation}
This transient servant asks and hopes that God, exalted be His glory, will confirm His loved ones, so that they may drink from the ocean of the meanings of the divine words and be so enkindled by the fire blazing within them that the promptings of devils will not keep them from the Lord of the Day of Judgment. In Káf and Rá a clamor has risen, and the source of conjecture and hypocrisy, with the utmost cunning and deceit and with fabricated words, has kept weak souls from the Lord of Oneness and is summoning them toward the liars, although he has never had, and does not now have, any knowledge of this Cause. Out of sheer desire he has taken exception to the Lord of Names and wanders bewildered in the wilderness of delusions. I ask God to guide him, not to deprive him of the choice wine of meanings and the flowing spring of truthfulness, and to grant him a share of the ocean of awareness. He is powerful and mighty over all things.
:::

### 11

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در کتاب اقدس که از ملکوت مقدّس الهی در اوّل ایّام سجن نازل ذکر ارض کاف و را و ما یحدث فیها از قلم اعلی جاری و ثبت شد و تا حال مستور ولکن ناعق آن ارض در این سنه بکلماتی تکلّم نموده که کادت السّموات ان تتفطّرن و تنشقّ الأرض و تخرّ الجبال مدّا
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar Kitāb-i Aqdas kih az malakūt-i muqaddas-i ilāhī dar avval-i ayyām-i sijn nāzil, dhikr-i arż-i Kāf va Rā va mā yaḥduthu fīhā az Qalam-i Aʿlā jārī va thabt shud va tā ḥāl mastūr, va-lākin nāʿiq-i ān arż dar īn sanih bi-kalimātī takallum namūdih kih kādati al-samāwātu an tatafaṭṭarna wa-tanshaqqa al-arḍu wa-takhirra al-jibālu maddan.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the Most Holy Book, which descended from the holy, divine Kingdom in the early days of the imprisonment, mention of the land of Káf and Rá and what would occur there flowed from the Most Exalted Pen and was recorded, and until now has remained concealed. Yet the clamorer of that land has this year uttered words at which the heavens have almost split apart, the earth rent asunder, and the mountains fallen flat.
:::

### 12

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حقّ انصاف عنایت فرماید و عدل و راستی بخشد امثال آن نفوس هزار و دویست سنه بل ازید ناس را به جابلقا و جابلسا دعوت نمودند و هر نفس آگاهی که اینکلمه را ردّ نمود و مردم را اخبار کرد که حضرت قائم در اصلاب است و باید متولّد شود فتوی بر قتلش دادند و خونش ریختند قسم بآفتاب افق بیان الرّحمن که از جمله آن نفوس همین ناعق ارض کاف و راء است چه که بر قدم آن نفوس مشی مینماید باری چه مقدار از نفوس مقدّسه بفتوای آن نفوس غافلهٴ جاهله کأس شهادت نوشیدند آنچه ذکر شد جمیع اولیا و دوستان الهی گواهی میدهند بر صدق آن بگمان خود نصرت امر حقّ مینمودند و ناس را بسبیل مستقیم هدایت میکردند و حال آنکه آن سبیل سبیل جحیم بود نه صراط مستقیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥaqq inṣāf ʿināyat farmāyad va ʿadl va rāstī bakhshad. Amthāl-i ān nufūs hizār va duvīst sanih bal azyad nās-rā bih Jābulqā va Jābulsā daʿvat namūdand va har nafs-i āgāhī kih īn kalimih-rā radd namūd va mardum-rā ikhbār kard kih Ḥaẓrat-i Qāʾim dar aṣlāb ast va bāyad mutavallid shavad, fatvā bar qatl-ash dādand va khūnash rīkhtand. Qasam bi-āftāb-i ufuq-i bayān-i al-Raḥmān kih az jumlih-yi ān nufūs hamīn nāʿiq-i arż-i Kāf va Rāʾ ast, chih kih bar qadam-i ān nufūs mashy mī-namāyad. Bārī chih miqdār az nufūs-i muqaddasih bi-fatvā-yi ān nufūs-i ghāfilih-yi jāhilih kaʾs-i shahādat nūshīdand. Ānchih dhikr shud jamīʿ-i awliyā va dūstān-i ilāhī guvāhī mī-dihand bar ṣidq-i ān. Bi-gumān-i khud nuṣrat-i amr-i Ḥaqq mī-namūdand va nās-rā bi-sabīl-i mustaqīm hidāyat mī-kardand va ḥāl ānkih ān sabīl sabīl-i jaḥīm būd nah ṣirāṭ-i mustaqīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
May God grant fairness and bestow justice and truthfulness. People like those souls summoned the people to Jábulqá and Jábulsá for twelve hundred years, indeed longer. Whenever an enlightened soul rejected this assertion and informed the people that the Qá’im was in the loins of His forebears and must be born, they issued a decree for his death and shed his blood. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of the All-Merciful’s utterance that this very clamorer of the land of Káf and Rá is among those souls, for he follows in their footsteps. How many holy souls drank the cup of martyrdom at the decree of those heedless, ignorant souls! All the loved ones and friends of God bear witness to the truth of what has been stated. They imagined that they were aiding the Cause of God and guiding people to the straight way, whereas that way was the way of hell, not the straight path.
:::

### 13

::: {.original lang="fa"}
آیا ناس را چه سکری اخذ نموده که تا حین بر حیله و مکر گروه منافقین اطّلاع نیافته‌اند آنحضرت دوستان الهی را آگاه فرمائید که خود را از مظاهر حیل و نفاق و مطالع خدعه و فریب باسم حقّ جلّ جلاله حفظ نمایند و از آنقوم مطمئن مشوند چه که مشاهده میشود چون از نفسی مأیوس شوند یعنی مشاهده نمایند اوهاماتشان در او تصرّف ننمود و تأثیر نکرد بلباس دوستی درآیند و بکمال محبّت و مودّت در ظاهر معاشرت نمایند و مقصودشان آنکه فرصت یابند و القا کنند آنچه را که در قلوبشان مستور است در هر حال اجتناب لازم باسباب دوستی اساس دشمنی را محکم نمایند اقبالشان اعراض و شفقتشان عداوت وصمتشان خدعه و نطقشان فریب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Āyā nās-rā chih sukrī akhdh namūdih kih tā ḥīn bar ḥīlih va makr-i gurūh-i munāfiqīn iṭṭilāʿ na-yāftih-and? Ān ḥaẓrat dūstān-i ilāhī-rā āgāh farmāyīd kih khud-rā az maẓāhir-i ḥiyal va nifāq va maṭāliʿ-i khudʿih va farīb bi-ism-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ḥifẓ namāyand va az ān qawm muṭmaʾin na-shavand, chih kih mushāhadih mī-shavad chūn az nafsī maʾyūs shavand, yaʿnī mushāhadih namāyand awhāmātishān dar ū taṣarruf na-namūd va taʾthīr na-kard, bi-libās-i dūstī dar-āyand va bi-kamāl-i maḥabbat va mavaddat dar ẓāhir muʿāsharat namāyand va maqṣūdishān ānkih furṣat yāband va ilqā kunand ānchih-rā kih dar qulūbishān mastūr ast. Dar har ḥāl ijtināb lāzim. Bi-asbāb-i dūstī asās-i dushmanī-rā muḥkam namāyand. Iqbālishān iʿrāż va shafaqatishān ʿadāvat va ṣamtishān khudʿih va nuṭqishān farīb.
:::

::: {.translation}
What intoxication has seized the people that, even now, they have not become aware of the deceit and cunning of the band of hypocrites? Please alert the friends of God to protect themselves, in the name of God, exalted be His glory, from the embodiments of guile and hypocrisy and the sources of deception and deceit, and not to place their trust in those people. For it is observed that when they lose hope of someone—that is, when they see that their delusions have neither taken hold of him nor influenced him—they assume the guise of friendship and outwardly associate with him with the utmost love and affection. Their purpose is to find an opportunity to instill what lies concealed in their hearts. Avoidance is necessary in every circumstance. Through the means of friendship they strengthen the foundations of enmity. Their approach is rejection, their kindness hostility, their silence deception, and their speech deceit.
:::

### 14

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بگوئید نای بیخردان فوارس مضمار انقطاع الیوم جز حقّ نبینند و جز حقّ نشناسند و جز حقّ نگویند چه که یوم یوم اللّه است لایُذکر فیه الّا هو الیوم اگر نفسی بغیر حقّ نطق نماید و ناظر باسماء موهومه شود او لایق اینمقام و این ذکر و این امر نبوده و نیست بگوئید ای غافلان از خدا بترسید و ناس بیچاره را بدام میندازید بگذارید بقوادم انقطاع در این هوا طیران نمایند و بکمال انبساط در این بساط وارد شوند یا لیت القوم یعرفون و یعلمون چندی قبل در یکی از الواح اینکلمهٴ علیا از لسان مالک وری جاری و نازل قوله تبارک و تعالی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bigūʾīd: \[corrupted text\] bī-khiradān, favāris-i miżmār-i inqiṭāʿ al-yawm juz Ḥaqq na-bīnand va juz Ḥaqq na-shināsand va juz Ḥaqq na-gūyand, chih kih yawm Yawm-i Allāh ast, lā yudhkaru fīhi illā Huwa. Al-yawm agar nafsī bi-ghayr-i Ḥaqq nuṭq namāyad va nāẓir bi-asmā-yi mawhūmih shavad, ū lāyiq-i īn maqām va īn dhikr va īn amr na-būdih va nīst. Bigūʾīd: Ay ghāfilān, az Khudā bitarsīd va nās-i bīchārih-rā bi-dām ma-yandāzīd. Bigudhārīd bi-qavādim-i inqiṭāʿ dar īn havā ṭayarān namāyand va bi-kamāl-i inbisāṭ dar īn bisāṭ vārid shavand. Yā layta al-qawma yaʿrifūna wa-yaʿlamūn. Chandī qabl dar yakī az alvāḥ īn kalimih-yi ʿulyā az lisān-i Mālik-i Varā jārī va nāzil. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā:
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: \[corrupted original text\] foolish ones, the riders in the arena of detachment today see none but God, recognize none but God, and speak of none but God, for this day is the Day of God, in which none is mentioned but Him. Today, if a soul speaks of anyone other than God and turns his gaze toward imaginary names, he has never been, and is not, worthy of this station, this mention, and this Cause. Say: Heedless ones, fear God and do not ensnare the helpless people. Let them fly in this atmosphere on the wings of detachment and enter this court with the utmost joy. If only the people would recognize and understand! Some time ago, in one of the Tablets, this exalted utterance flowed from the tongue of the Lord of all creation and was sent down. His words—blessed and exalted be He:
:::

### 15

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ای عبد حاضر آیا این خلق تفکّر نمینمایند در عظمت این یوم امروز روزیست که بزرگی آن در جمیع کتب الهی از قلم اعلی مذکور و مسطور است اگرچه ایّام ظهور مظاهر احدیّه و مطالع نور الهیّه در مقامی بایّام اللّه مذکور ولکن این ایّام در جمیع کتب تخصیص یافته و مخصوص است بحقّ جلّ جلاله چنانچه بخاتم انبیا میفرماید یوم یقوم النّاس لربّ العالمین و همچنین الملک یومئذ للّه و جئی ربّک و الملک صفّاً صفّا و امثال آن و به کلیم میفرماید ان اخرج القوم من الظّلمات الی النّور و ذکّرهم بایّام اللّه جمیع رسل را باین یوم مبارک بشارت میفرماید مع‌ذلک گاهی مرآت هنگامی وصیّ و وقتی ثمره میگویند باین اسماء عاکفند و شاعر نیستند یتکلّمون و لا یشعرون یقولون و لا یفقهون قل موتوا بغیظکم هذا یوم اللّه لو انتم تعرفون و هذا امر اللّه لو انتم تنصفون قد ظهر من کان مکنوناً فی علم اللّه و مسطوراً فی کتبه و به ظهر کلّ امر مختوم و کلّ سرّ مخزون انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ey ʿabd-e ḥāżer, āyā īn khalq tafakkor nemīnamāyand dar ʿaẓamat-e īn yowm? Emrūz rūzīst ke bozorgī-ye ān dar jamīʿ-e kotob-e elāhī az qalam-e aʿlā madhkūr va masṭūr ast. Agarche ayyām-e ẓohūr-e maẓāher-e aḥadīyye va maṭāleʿ-e nūr-e elāhīyye dar maqāmī be-ayyām Allāh madhkūr, va lāken īn ayyām dar jamīʿ-e kotob takhṣīṣ yāfte va makhṣūṣ ast be-Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu. Chenānche be-Khātam-e Anbiyā mīfarmāyad: yawma yaqūmu al-nāsu li-rabbi al-ʿālamīn; va hamchenīn: al-mulku yawmaʾidhin li-llāh; va jāʾa rabbuka wa-l-malaku ṣaffan ṣaffā; va amthāl-e ān. Va be-Kalīm mīfarmāyad: an akhrij al-qawma mina al-ẓulumāti ilā al-nūri wa-dhakkirhum bi-ayyāmi Allāh. Jamīʿ-e rosol rā be-īn yowm-e mobārak beshārat mīfarmāyad. Maʿa dhālek gāhī merʾāt, hengāmī vaṣī va vaqtī thamare mīgūyand; be-īn asmā ʿākefand va shāʿer nīstand. Yatakallamūna wa-lā yashʿurūn, yaqūlūna wa-lā yafqahūn. Qul mūtū bi-ghayẓikum. Hādhā yawmu Allāh law antum taʿrifūn, wa-hādhā amru Allāh law antum tunṣifūn. Qad ẓahara man kāna maknūnan fī ʿilmi Allāh wa-masṭūran fī kutubihi, wa-bihi ẓahara kullu amrin makhtūmin wa-kullu sirrin makhzūn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O servant in attendance, do these people not reflect on the greatness of this Day? Today is a day whose greatness has been mentioned and recorded by the Most Exalted Pen in all the divine Books. Although the days of the appearance of the Manifestations of divine unity and the Dawning-Places of divine light are, in one sense, called the Days of God, these days have been singled out in all the Books and belong especially to God, exalted be His glory. Thus He says to the Seal of the Prophets: “The day when the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds”; and likewise: “Sovereignty on that day belongs to God”; and “Your Lord comes, and the angels, rank upon rank,” and other such statements. And to Him who conversed with God He says: “Bring the people out of darkness into light, and remind them of the Days of God.” He gives all the Messengers the glad tidings of this blessed Day. Nevertheless, at one time they speak of a mirror, at another of a successor, and at another of a fruit. They cling to these names and are unaware. They speak without awareness; they utter words without understanding. Say: “Die in your rage! This is the Day of God, if only you recognized it, and this is the Cause of God, if only you judged fairly. He who was concealed in the knowledge of God and recorded in His Books has appeared, and through Him every sealed matter and every hidden secret has been disclosed.” End of quotation.
:::

### 16

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حال از پستی نفوس ذباب بر ربّ الأرباب اعتراض نموده غراب را از عالم معانی قسمتی نه و ذباب را از ترنّمات الهی نصیبی نه این میدان را فوارس عرفان باید تا باسم حقّ جلّ جلاله مرکب همّت رانند سبحان‌اللّه بعضی از نفوس محض هوی تکلّم نموده و مینمایند چه که از خمر اوهام نوشیده‌اند و غیر اللّه را ربّ اخذ کرده‌اند در بادهای ظنون مشی نمایند و باوهامات خود ناس را گمراه کنند اگر خادم در اینمقامات آنچه شنیده عرض نماید البتّه اوراق سخن کفایت ننماید آیاتیکه در اوّل ورود سجن در کتاب اقدس نازل ذکر میشود که شاید غافلین بشعور آیند و نائمین متنبّه شوند و قاعدین قیام نمایند قوله عزّ بیانه و جلّ مقامه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥāl az pastī-ye nofūs, dhobāb bar Rabb al-Arbāb eʿterāż namūde. Ghorāb rā az ʿālam-e maʿānī qesmatī na va dhobāb rā az tarannomāt-e elāhī naṣībī na. Īn meydān rā favāres-e ʿerfān bāyad tā be-esm-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, markab-e hemmat rānand. Sobḥān Allāh! Baʿżī az nofūs maḥż-e havā takallom namūde va mīnamāyand, che ke az khamr-e owhām nūshīde-and va gheyr Allāh rā rabb akhdh karde-and. Dar bādhā-ye ẓonūn mashy namāyand va be-owhāmāt-e khod nās rā gomrāh konand. Agar khādem dar īn maqāmāt ānche shenīde ʿarż namāyad, al-batte owrāq-e sokhan kefāyat nanamāyad. Āyātī ke dar avval-e vorūd-e sejn dar Ketāb-e Aqdas nāzel dhekr mīshavad ke shāyad ghāfelīn be-shoʿūr āyand va nāʾemīn motanabbeh shavand va qāʿedīn qīyām namāyand. Qawluhu ʿazza bayānuhu wa-jalla maqāmuhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
Now, such is the baseness of these souls that a fly has raised objections against the Lord of lords. The raven has no share in the realm of inner meanings, and the fly has no portion of the divine melodies. This arena calls for the horsemen of spiritual knowledge to spur on the steed of endeavor in the name of God, exalted be His glory. Glory be to God! Some souls have spoken, and continue to speak, out of sheer desire, for they have drunk the wine of delusions and taken someone other than God as their lord. They move amid the winds of conjecture and lead people astray with their imaginings. If this servant were to relate what he has heard concerning these matters, pages of discourse would certainly not suffice. The verses revealed in the Most Holy Book upon first entering the prison are cited here, so that perhaps the heedless may become aware, the sleeping may awaken, and those who sit idle may arise. His words—mighty is His utterance and exalted His station:
:::

### 17

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ان یا ارض الکاف و الرّاء انّا نراک علی ما لایحبّه اللّه و نری منک ما لا اطّلع به الّا اللّه العلیم الخبیر و نجد ما تمرّ منک فی سرّ السّرّ عندنا علم کلّشیء فی لوح مبین لا تحزنی بذلک سوف یظهر اللّه فیک اولی بأس شدید یذکروننی باستقامة لا تمنعهم اشارات العلمآء و لا تحجبهم شبهات المریبین اولئک ینظرنّ اللّه بأعینهم و ینصرنّه بأنفسهم الا انّه من الرّاسخین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In yā arḍa al-Kāf wa-l-Rāʾ, innā narāki ʿalā mā lā yuḥibbuhu Allāh, wa-narā minki mā lā iṭṭalaʿa bihi illā Allāhu al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr, wa-najidu mā tamurru minki fī sirri al-sirr. ʿIndanā ʿilmu kulli shayʾin fī lawḥin mubīn. Lā taḥzanī bi-dhālika. Sawfa yuẓhiru Allāhu fīki ulī baʾsin shadīdin yadhkurūnanī bi-istiqāmatin lā tamnaʿuhum ishārātu al-ʿulamāʾ wa-lā taḥjubuhum shubuhātu al-murībīn. Ulāʾika yanẓurunna Allāha bi-aʿyunihim wa-yanṣurunnahu bi-anfusihim. Alā innahu mina al-rāsikhīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O land of Kaf and Ra! We see you in a state displeasing to God, and We see from you what none but God, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware, has perceived. We discern what proceeds from you in the deepest secrecy. With Us is the knowledge of all things in a clear Tablet. Do not grieve over this. God will raise up within you people of great might who will remember Me with a steadfastness that neither the allusions of the learned can hinder nor the doubts of the doubters veil. They will surely behold God with their own eyes and aid Him with their own selves. Truly, he is among the steadfast. End of quotation.
:::

### 18

::: {.original lang="fa"}
وقتی این آیات نازل که ذکر ناعق آن ارض نبوده و کتاب اقدس ده سنه قبل آن نازل و کلّ مطّلعند لازال نفوس جاهله خود را برداء و عمّامه میآراستند و در لباس علم باب آنرا سدّ مینمودند آیا کدام یک از روایات و احادیث و اخبارشان صدق و مطابق بوده عباد بیچاره از جهل آن نفوس غافله قرنها در تیه اوهام و ظنون سائر باری لوجه اللّه گفته میشود که شاید بنیان وهم را تجدید ننمایند و اساس ظنون را بر ارض نگذارند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Vaqtī īn āyāt nāzel ke dhekr-e nāʿeq-e ān arż nabūde va Ketāb-e Aqdas dah sane qabl-e ān nāzel va koll moṭṭaleʿand. Lā yazāl nofūs-e jāhele khod rā be-radā va ʿamāme mīārāstand va dar lebās-e ʿelm bāb-e ān rā sadd mīnamūdand. Āyā kodām yek az revāyāt va aḥādīth va akhbāreshān ṣedq va moṭābeq būde? ʿEbād-e bīchāre az jahl-e ān nofūs-e ghāfele qarnhā dar tīh-e owhām va ẓonūn sāʾer. Bārī, li-wajhi Allāh gofte mīshavad ke shāyad bonyān-e vahm rā tajdīd nanamāyand va asās-e ẓonūn rā bar arż nagodhārand.
:::

::: {.translation}
These verses were revealed when there was no mention of the clamorer of that land, and the Most Holy Book was revealed ten years before that, as everyone knows. Ignorant souls have always adorned themselves with cloaks and turbans and, in the guise of learning, barred its door. Which of their traditions, sayings, and reports has proved true and accorded with reality? Because of the ignorance of those heedless souls, the hapless people have wandered for centuries in the wilderness of delusions and conjectures. In any event, this is said for the sake of God, so that perhaps they may not rebuild the structure of delusion or lay the foundations of conjecture upon the earth.
:::

### 19

::: {.original lang="fa"}
امروز باید بقوّت خلیل آفاق سلاسل تقلید را بشکنند و اصنام اوهام را از هم بریزند گوش را باید از آنچه شنیده‌اند مقدّس نمایند از گفتگوها بگذرند و از اقوال بافعال توجّه نمایند بفرمائید ای غافلان من قام علی الأمر و من الّذی دعا الکلّ الی الأفق الأعلی فی ایّام فیها اضطربت افئدة اولی النّهی سبحان‌اللّه امروز را چه دانسته‌اند و از این ظهور اعظم چه ادراک نموده‌اند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Emrūz bāyad be-qovvat-e Khalīl-e āfāq salāsel-e taqlīd rā beshkanand va aṣnām-e owhām rā az ham berīzand. Gūsh rā bāyad az ānche shenīde-and moqaddas namāyand, az goftogūhā bogdharand va az aqvāl be-afʿāl tavajjoh namāyand. Befarmāyīd: ey ghāfelān, man qāma ʿalā al-amri wa-man alladhī daʿā al-kulla ilā al-ufuq al-aʿlā fī ayyāmin fīhā iḍṭarabat afʾidatu ulī al-nuhā? Sobḥān Allāh! Emrūz rā che dāneste-and va az īn ẓohūr-e aʿẓam che edrāk namūde-and?
:::

::: {.translation}
Today they must, through the power of the Friend of all the world, break the chains of imitation and shatter the idols of delusion. They must purify their ears of what they have heard, leave discussions behind, and turn from words to deeds. Say: “O heedless ones, who arose to uphold the Cause, and who called everyone to the Most Exalted Horizon in days when the hearts of those endowed with understanding were shaken?” Glory be to God! What have they understood of this Day, and what have they perceived of this Most Great Revelation?
:::

### 20

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هذا یوم لا یذکر فیه الّا هو و لا ینبغی لأحد ان یتمسّک بالأمثال و الأشباه و الأسمآء هذا یوم نطقت بثنائه کتب اللّه و شهد له النّبیّون و المرسلون انسان متحیّر است چه ذکر نماید حزب شیعه که خود را اعظم و اعلم و اتقی از جمیع احزاب عالم میشمردند نزد اشراقات انوار آفتاب ظهور واضح و مبرهن شد که پستترین احزابند چه که بفتوای آن نفوس محبوب عالمیان را در ارض تا شهید نمودند الا لعنة اللّه علی القوم الظّالمین باینهم قناعت ننمودند فتوی بر قتل جمیع نفوس مقدّسه دادند چه مقدار از اطفال و نساء که از ظلم آن نفوس شهید شدند و چه مقدار که بی محلّ و مأوی و بی مربّی ماندند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Hādhā yawmun lā yudhkaru fīhi illā huwa, wa-lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin an yatamassaka bi-l-amthāli wa-l-ashbāhi wa-l-asmāʾ. Hādhā yawmun naṭaqat bi-thanāʾihi kutubu Allāh wa-shahida lahu al-nabiyyūna wa-l-mursalūn. Ensān motaḥayyer ast che dhekr namāyad. Ḥezb-e Shīʿe ke khod rā aʿẓam va aʿlam va atqā az jamīʿ-e aḥzāb-e ʿālam mīshomordand, nazd-e eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e ẓohūr vāżeḥ va mobarhan shod ke past-tarīn-e aḥzāband, che ke be-fatvā-ye ān nofūs Maḥbūb-e ʿālamīyān rā dar arż-e Tā shahīd namūdand. Alā laʿnatu Allāhi ʿalā al-qawmi al-ẓālimīn. Be-īn ham qanāʿat nanamūdand; fatvā bar qatl-e jamīʿ-e nofūs-e moqaddase dādand. Che meqdār az aṭfāl va nesā ke az ẓolm-e ān nofūs shahīd shodand va che meqdār ke bī maḥall va maʾvā va bī morabbī māndand.
:::

::: {.translation}
This is a Day in which none is mentioned but Him, and no one should cling to likenesses, counterparts, or names. This is a Day whose praise the Books of God have voiced and to which the Prophets and Messengers have borne witness. One is bewildered as to what to say. The Shiite community considered itself greater, more learned, and more pious than all the communities of the world; yet in the radiance of the light of the Sun of Revelation, it became clear and evident that they are the lowest of communities, for it was by the ruling of those souls that the Beloved of all the worlds was martyred in the land of Ta. Truly, the curse of God rests upon the unjust people. Nor were they content with this: they issued a ruling for the killing of all the holy souls. How many children and women were martyred through the oppression of those souls, and how many were left without a home, a refuge, or anyone to care for them!
:::

### 21

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حال تازه جمعی از کذّابهای عالم جمع شده‌اند و در صدد ترتیب اساس قبل بوده و هستند ناعق ارض کاف و را و ناعقین اخری بر آنند که انوار آفتاب راستی را بغمام ظنون جدیده ستر نمایند و دو سه هزار سنهٴ دیگر به ردّ و قبول و اعراض و اعتراض و سبّ و لعن یکدیگر بر منابر و مجالس مشغول شوند قسم بآفتاب افق تقدیس اینعبد از این اذکار خجل و منفعل است جمیع علمای عصر که هر یک در ایران پیشوا بودند و صاحب منبر و محراب عرف حقیقت را علی قدر سمّ ابره نیافتند چه اگر یافته بودند این ظلم جدید لا مثل له در عالم واقع نمیشد محض هوی و ریاست تکلّم نمودند بآنچه که سبب و علّت شهادت مقصود عالم نقطهٴ اولی روح ما سواه فداه گشت چه اگر آن اذکار مجعوله نبود حقّ و اولیائش شهید نمیشدند جمیع علما در سنهٴ اوّل ذکر نمودند که جمیع علما از قبل و بعد بر این بوده‌اند که آنحضرت باید از جابلقا و جابلسا ظاهر شود و حال این حزب میگویند در شیراز متولّد شد لذا جمیع حکم بر کفر و سفک دم مطهّر نمودند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥāl tāze jamʿī az kadhdhābhā-ye ʿālam jamʿ shode-and va dar ṣadad-e tartīb-e asās-e qabl būde va hastand. Nāʿeq-e arż-e Kāf va Rā va nāʿeqīn-e okhrā bar ānand ke anvār-e āftāb-e rāstī rā be-ghamām-e ẓonūn-e jadīde satr namāyand va do se hezār sane-ye dīgar be-radd va qabūl va eʿrāż va eʿterāż va sabb va laʿn-e yekdīgar bar manāber va majāles mashghūl shavand. Qasam be-āftāb-e ofoq-e taqdīs, īn ʿabd az īn adhkār khajel va monfaʿel ast. Jamīʿ-e ʿolamā-ye ʿaṣr ke har yek dar Īrān pīshvā būdand va ṣāḥeb-e menbar va meḥrāb, ʿarf-e ḥaqīqat rā ʿalā qadr-e samm-e ebre nayāftand, che agar yāfte būdand īn ẓolm-e jadīd-e lā methla lah dar ʿālam vāqeʿ nemīshod. Maḥż-e havā va rīyāsat takallom namūdand be-ānche ke sabab va ʿellat-e shahādat-e Maqṣūd-e ʿālam, Noqṭe-ye Ūlā, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, gasht, che agar ān adhkār-e majʿūle nabūd Ḥaqq va owlīyāyash shahīd nemīshodand. Jamīʿ-e ʿolamā dar sane-ye avval dhekr namūdand ke jamīʿ-e ʿolamā az qabl va baʿd bar īn būde-and ke ān Ḥażrat bāyad az Jābolqā va Jābolsā ẓāher shavad va ḥāl īn ḥezb mīgūyand dar Shīrāz motavalled shod. Ledhā jamīʿ ḥokm bar kofr va safk-e dam-e moṭahhar namūdand.
:::

::: {.translation}
Now a fresh gathering of the world’s liars has assembled, and they have been, and remain, intent on reconstructing the former foundations. The clamorer of the land of Kaf and Ra and the other clamorers intend to veil the light of the Sun of Truth with the clouds of new conjectures, and to spend another two or three thousand years rejecting and accepting, turning away and objecting, reviling and cursing one another from pulpits and in assemblies. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of holiness, this servant is ashamed and abashed to mention these things. All the divines of the age, each of whom was a leader in Iran and occupied a pulpit and a prayer niche, failed to perceive even a needle’s eye’s measure of the fragrance of truth. Had they perceived it, this new and unparalleled oppression would not have occurred in the world. Out of sheer desire and ambition for leadership, they uttered what became the cause and occasion of the martyrdom of the Desire of the world, the Primal Point—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him. Had it not been for those fabricated statements, God and His loved ones would not have been martyred. In the first year, all the divines declared that the divines, earlier and later alike, had held that He must appear from Jabulqa and Jabulsa, whereas this community now said that He had been born in Shiraz. Thus they all pronounced Him an unbeliever and decreed the shedding of His pure blood.
:::

### 22

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا حبیب فؤادی قدری تفکّر لازم است تا بر ظلم این فئه مطّلع شوید و بعضی را آگاه نمائید اکثری از عباد بتقلید متمسّکند و بهوی مبتلا سیل ظنون و اوهامشان بنیان ایمان را ویران نمود افّ لهم و للّذین اتّبعوهم غفلت بمقامی رسیده که باوهامات خود شرایط از برای ظهور ترتیب داده‌اند و به اشارات و ادراکات خود او را محدود نموده‌اند و چون مخالف ظنون خود یافته‌اند ضوضاء مرتفع بگوئید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ḥabība fuʾādī, qadrī tafakkor lāzem ast tā bar ẓolm-e īn feʾe moṭṭaleʿ shavīd va baʿżī rā āgāh namāyīd. Aktharī az ʿebād be-taqlīd motamassekand va be-havā mobtalā. Seyl-e ẓonūn va owhāmeshān bonyān-e īmān rā vīrān namūd. Uffin lahum wa-li-lladhīna ittabaʿūhum. Ghaflat be-maqāmī resīde ke be-owhāmāt-e khod sharāyeṭ az barā-ye ẓohūr tartīb dāde-and va be-eshārāt va edrākāt-e khod ū rā maḥdūd namūde-and va chon mokhālef-e ẓonūn-e khod yāfte-and ḍowḍāʾ mortafeʿ. Begūyīd:
:::

::: {.translation}
O beloved of my heart, some reflection is necessary, so that you may become aware of the oppression of this faction and alert others. Most people cling to imitation and are afflicted by desire. The flood of their conjectures and delusions has destroyed the foundation of faith. Fie upon them and those who have followed them! Their heedlessness has reached such a degree that, through their own imaginings, they have devised conditions for the Revelation and have confined Him within their own allusions and conceptions. When they found Him contrary to their conjectures, an uproar arose. Say:
:::

### 23

::: {.original lang="ar"}
این نبأ عظیم در اثبات امرش محتاج بتصدیق احدی نبوده و نیست فانظروا ما نطق به نقطة البیان روح من فی الامکان فداه قوله تبارک و تعالی و قد کتبت جوهرة فی ذکره و هو انّه لا یستشار باشارتی و لا بما ذکر فی البیان الی قوله جلّ و عزّ فانّه اجلّ و اعلی من ان یکون معروفا بدونه او مستشیراً باشارة خلقه و انّنی انا اوّل عبد قد آمنت به و یآیاته و اخذت من ابکار حدائق جنّة عرفانه حدائق کلماته بلی وعزّته هو الحقّ لا اله الّا هو کلّ بأمره قائمون انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn Nabaʾ-e ʿAẓīm dar ethbāt-e amrash moḥtāj be-taṣdīq-e aḥadī nabūde va nīst. Fa-nẓurū mā naṭaqa bihi Nuqṭatu al-Bayān, rūḥu man fī al-imkāni fidāhu. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: wa-qad katabtu jawharatan fī dhikrihi wa-huwa annahu lā yustashāru bi-ishāratī wa-lā bi-mā dhukira fī al-Bayān. Ilā qawlihi jalla wa-ʿazza: fa-innahu ajallu wa-aʿlā min an yakūna maʿrūfan bi-dūnihi aw mustashīran bi-ishārati khalqihi, wa-innanī anā awwalu ʿabdin qad āmantu bihi wa-\[corrupted text\] wa-akhadhtu min abkāri ḥadāʾiqi jannati ʿirfānihi ḥadāʾiqa kalimātihi. Balā wa-ʿizzatihi, huwa al-Ḥaqqu lā ilāha illā huwa, kullun bi-amrihi qāʾimūn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
This Great Announcement has never needed, nor does He now need, anyone’s confirmation to establish His Cause. Consider, then, what the Point of the Bayan—may the souls of all within the realm of existence be sacrificed for Him—has uttered. His words, blessed and exalted be He: “I have written a jewel concerning His mention, namely that He is not to be consulted through My allusion, nor through what has been mentioned in the Bayan.” And further on, His words, glorified and mighty be He: “For He is too glorious and exalted to be known through anyone other than Himself or to seek counsel through the allusion of His creation. I am indeed the first servant to have believed in Him and \[corrupted original text\], and from the pristine gardens of the paradise of His recognition I have taken the gardens of His words. Yes, by His might! He is the Truth; there is no god but Him. All subsist through His command.” End of quotation.
:::

### 24

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اَین الآذان الواعیه و اَین الأبصار الحدیده تا اشراقات انوار آفتاب بیانرا مشاهده نمایند و ندای حقّ جلّ جلاله را استماع کنند اگر جمیع من فی البیان در همین یکفقره از روی انصاف و عدل ملاحظه و تفکّر نمایند کلّ بشطر اقدس توجّه کنند و از ما عندالنّاس غافل و بما عنداللّه متمسّک گردند ولکن چه فائده که آذان را قطن اغراض از اصغا منع نموده و ابصار را حجابهای ظنون و اوهام از مشاهده باز داشته
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ayna al-ādhānu al-wāʿiya wa-ayna al-abṣāru al-ḥadīda, tā eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e bayān rā moshāhede namāyand va nedā-ye Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, rā estemāʿ konand? Agar jamīʿ-e man fī al-Bayān dar hamīn yek feqre az rū-ye enṣāf va ʿadl molāḥeẓe va tafakkor namāyand, koll be-shaṭr-e aqdas tavajjoh konand va az mā ʿenda al-nās ghāfel va be-mā ʿenda Allāh motamassek gardand. Va lāken che fāʾede ke ādhān rā qoṭn-e aghrāż az eṣghā manʿ namūde va abṣār rā ḥejābhā-ye ẓonūn va owhām az moshāhede bāz dāshte.
:::

::: {.translation}
Where are the attentive ears, and where are the keen eyes, that they may behold the radiance of the light of the Sun of Utterance and hear the call of God, exalted be His glory? If all the people of the Bayan were to consider and reflect on this one passage with fairness and justice, they would all turn toward the Most Holy, disregard what is with people, and cling to what is with God. But what use is it, when the cotton of self-interest has prevented ears from hearing, and the veils of conjectures and delusions have kept eyes from seeing?
:::

### 25

::: {.original lang="ar"}
وقتی از اوقات اینکلمهٴ علیا از مشرق وحی مالک اسماء ظاهر و نازل قوله تبارک و تعالی ای عبد حاضر ملاحظه کن پلک باین رقیقی که مشاهده میشود اگر حجاب گردد چشم از مشاهدهٴ آسمان و زمین و آنچه در اوست از اشجار و انهار و بحار و جبال و اثمار و الوان و ما عندهم محروم و ممنوع ماند حال اگر حجاب غلیظ ظنون بر قلب وارد شود چه خواهد نمود ای عبد حاضر از حقّ بطلب کلّ را از حجبات مانعه مقدّس فرماید که شاید بمقصود از خلقت خلق پی برند و بعرفان کنز مکنون مختوم فائز شوند و از این رحیق مختوم بیاشامند انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Vaqtī az owqāt īn kalame-ye ʿolyā az mashreq-e vaḥy-e Mālek-e Asmā ẓāher va nāzel. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: ey ʿabd-e ḥāżer, molāḥeẓe kon, pelk be-īn raqīqī ke moshāhede mīshavad agar ḥejāb gardad, chashm az moshāhede-ye āsmān va zamīn va ānche dar ūst az ashjār va anhār va beḥār va jebāl va athmār va alvān va mā ʿendahom maḥrūm va mamnūʿ mānad. Ḥāl agar ḥejāb-e ghalīẓ-e ẓonūn bar qalb vāred shavad che khāhad namūd? Ey ʿabd-e ḥāżer, az Ḥaqq beṭalab koll rā az ḥojobāt-e māneʿe moqaddas farmāyad ke shāyad be-maqṣūd az khelqat-e khalq pey barand va be-ʿerfān-e kanz-e maknūn-e makhtūm fāʾez shavand va az īn raḥīq-e makhtūm bīyāshāmand. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
On one occasion, this exalted utterance appeared and was revealed from the Dawning-Place of the revelation of the Lord of Names. His words, blessed and exalted be He: “O servant in attendance, consider: the eyelid, thin as it is seen to be, if it becomes a veil, leaves the eye deprived and prevented from beholding the heavens and the earth and all they contain—trees, rivers, seas, mountains, fruits, colors, and all that is with them. Now, if the thick veil of conjectures should fall upon the heart, what will it do? O servant in attendance, ask God to purify everyone of obstructing veils, so that perhaps they may discern the purpose of the creation of humankind, attain recognition of the hidden, sealed Treasure, and drink of this sealed choice wine.” End of quotation.
:::

### 26

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری جوهر بیان بتصدیق محبوب عالمیان آنکه مشرق آیات و مطلع بیّنات باشارهٴ آنسلطان وجود و بما نزّل فی البیان منوط نه و کلّ مأمورند او را بنفس او بشناسند در اینمقام بعضی از اسرار از لسان مطلع اسماء شنیده شد که اینعبد من‌غیر اذن جسارت بر عرض آن ندارد یا لیت القوم یعلمون و یعرفون طوبی از برای نفسیکه ببصر خود بافق اعلی توجّه نماید و انوار وجه را من‌غیر سبحات و اشارات ادراک کند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bārī, Jowhar-e Bayān be-taṣdīq-e Maḥbūb-e ʿālamīyān ānke Mashreq-e Āyāt va Maṭlaʿ-e Bayyenāt be-eshāre-ye ān Solṭān-e Vojūd va be-mā nuzzila fī al-Bayān manūṭ na va koll maʾmūrand ū rā be-nafs-e ū beshenāsand. Dar īn maqām baʿżī az asrār az lesān-e Maṭlaʿ-e Asmā shenīde shod ke īn ʿabd men gheyr-e edhn jasārat bar ʿarż-e ān nadārad. Yā layta al-qawma yaʿlamūna wa-yaʿrifūn. Ṭūbā az barā-ye nafsī ke be-baṣar-e khod be-Ofoq-e Aʿlā tavajjoh namāyad va anvār-e vajh rā men gheyr-e soboḥāt va eshārāt edrāk konad.
:::

::: {.translation}
In short, the essence of the Bayan, as confirmed by the Beloved of all the worlds, is that the Dawning-Place of the Verses and the Dayspring of Clear Proofs is not dependent on the allusion of that Sovereign of existence or on what was revealed in the Bayan, and that all are commanded to recognize Him through His own Self. Concerning this station, certain mysteries were heard from the tongue of the Dayspring of Names, which this servant does not dare to relate without permission. If only the people knew and recognized! Blessed is the soul who turns toward the Most Exalted Horizon with his own eyes and perceives the light of the Face without veils of glory or allusions.
:::

### 27

::: {.original lang="fa"}
سکر بادهٴ غرور و غفلت اکثری را محجوب نموده ساذج قدمی را که نقطهٴ بیان روح ما سواه فداه میفرماید انّنی انا اوّل عبد قد آمنت به و بآیاته در باره‌اش گفته‌اند آنچه را که آسمان از او منفطر و ملکوت اسماء از آن مضطرب فی‌الحقیقه اگر نفسی در اینکلمات مبارکه که از مشرق بیان حقّ جلّ جلاله اشراق نموده تفکّر نماید و بر لآلی بیان مطّلع گردد خود را غنی و مستغنی از کلّ مشاهده کند بپرهای اطمینان در هواء قدس رحمن طیران نماید و از کوثر استقامت بیاشامد امروز اگر نفسی اقلّ من آن توقّف کند از اهل نار محسوب عند ذکرش جمیع اذکار مفقود و عند بیانش جمیع بیان خاضع
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Sokr-e bāde-ye ghorūr va ghaflat aksarī rā maḥjūb namūde. Sādhaj-e qidamī rā ke Noqṭe-ye Bayān, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, mīfarmāyad: “Innanī anā awwalu ʿabdin qad āmantu bihi wa-bi-āyātihi,” dar bāre-ash gofte-and ānche rā ke āsmān az ū monfaṭer va malakūt-e asmā az ān możṭareb. Fī’l-ḥaqīqe agar nafsī dar īn kalemāt-e mobārake ke az mashreq-e bayān-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, eshrāq namūde tafakkor namāyad va bar laʾālī-ye bayān moṭṭaleʿ gardad, khod rā ghanī va mostaghnī az koll moshāhede konad, be-parhā-ye eṭmīnān dar havā-ye qods-e Raḥmān ṭayarān namāyad va az kawthar-e esteqāmat biyāshāmad. Emrūz agar nafsī aqall-e men ān tavaqqof konad, az ahl-e nār maḥsūb. ʿEnd-e dhekrash jamīʿ-e adhkār mafqūd va ʿend-e bayānash jamīʿ-e bayān khāżeʿ.
:::

::: {.translation}
Intoxication with the wine of pride and heedlessness has veiled the majority. Of Him who is the pure Essence of eternity, concerning whom the Point of the Bayan—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—says, “I am indeed the first servant to have believed in Him and His verses,” they have said things that cause heaven to split apart and the kingdom of names to tremble. In truth, if anyone reflects on these blessed words that have shone from the Dayspring of the utterance of God, exalted be His glory, and discovers the pearls of His utterance, he will find himself rich and independent of all, soar on the wings of assurance in the holy atmosphere of the All-Merciful, and drink from the river of steadfastness. Today, if anyone hesitates for less than an instant, he is counted among the people of the fire. At His mention, all other mentions vanish, and before His utterance, every utterance bows.
:::

### 28

::: {.original lang="fa"}
وقتی از اوقات فرمودند یا عبد حاضر امروز ملکوت بیان لدی الرّحمن خاضع و خاشع جمیع کتب و الواح باراده معلّق و منوط و جمیع من فی البیان باین ذکر اعظم و نبأ عظیم و عرفانش مأمور طوبی از برای نفسیکه سلاسل اوهام و ظنون را باسم حضرت قیّوم شکست از ما عندالخلق گذشت و بما عندالحقّ تمسّک جست انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Vaqtī az awqāt farmūdand: “Yā ʿabd-e ḥāżer, emrūz malakūt-e bayān ladā al-Raḥmān khāżeʿ va khāsheʿ. Jamīʿ-e kotob va alvāḥ be-erāde moʿallaq va manūṭ va jamīʿ-e man fī al-Bayān be-īn Dhekr-e Aʿẓam va Nabaʾ-e ʿAẓīm va ʿerfānash maʾmūr. Ṭūbā az barā-ye nafsī ke salāsel-e awhām va ẓonūn rā be-esm-e Ḥażrat-e Qayyūm shekast, az mā ʿenda al-khalq godhasht va be-mā ʿenda al-Ḥaqq tamassok jost.” Entahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
On one occasion He said: “O servant in attendance, today the kingdom of utterance bows in humble submission before the All-Merciful. All books and tablets depend upon His will and are subject to it, and all who are in the Bayan are commanded to turn to this Most Great Remembrance and momentous Announcement and to recognize Him. Blessed is the soul who, through the name of the Self-Subsisting, has broken the chains of vain imaginings and conjectures, passed beyond what is with the people, and held fast to what is with God.” End of quotation.
:::

### 29

::: {.original lang="fa"}
امثال آن نفوس معرضه لازال بوده‌اند اگر نفسی بعد از ارتقا حضرت عسکری علیه سلام اللّه در امورات واقعه ودسایس علمای زنادقه تفکّر نماید شهادت میدهد بر اینکه جمیع فساد عالم از آن نفوس بوده و هست لعمر ربّنا اگر کذب رؤسا نبود ربّ اعلی بظلم اعدا شهید نمیشد حضرت موهومی بر سریر موهومی معیّن نمودند و بروایات موهومه ثابت کردند آنچه را که سبب سفک دم سیّد عالم و جواهر امم شد و گاهی تواقیع جعلیّه ظاهر مینمودند و نسبتش را بمبدء وجود میدادند الا لعنة اللّه علی القوم الکاذبین در باطن مقصود اعلاء علوّ و سموّ خودشان بود ولکن در ظاهر بخرائر اشاره مینمودند گاهی جابلقا و هنگامی جابلسا و وقتی ناحیهٴ کذبه که بمقدّسه مینامیدند سلطان لایزالی را که نقطهٴ بیان روح ما سواه فداه در ذکرش میفرماید قوله عزّ ذکره انّه اجلّ و اعلی من ان یکون معروفاً بدونه او مستشیراً باشارة خلقه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Amthāl-e ān nofūs-e moʿreże lā yazāl būde-and. Agar nafsī baʿd az erteqā-ye Ḥażrat-e ʿAskarī, ʿalayhi salāmu Allāh, dar omūrāt-e vāqeʿe va dasāyes-e ʿolamā-ye zanādeqe tafakkor namāyad, shahādat mīdahad bar īnke jamīʿ-e fasād-e ʿālam az ān nofūs būde va hast. La-ʿamri Rabbinā, agar kedhb-e roʾasā nabūd, Rabb-e Aʿlā be-ẓolm-e aʿdā shahīd nemīshod. Ḥażrat-e mawhūmī bar sarīr-e mawhūmī moʿayyan namūdand va be-revāyāt-e mawhūme thābet kardand ānche rā ke sabab-e safk-e dam-e Sayyed-e ʿālam va javāher-e omam shod, va gāhī tavāqīʿ-e jaʿliyye ẓāher mīnamūdand va nesbatash rā be-mabdaʾ-e vojūd mīdādand. A-lā laʿnatu Allāhi ʿalā al-qawmi al-kādhibīn. Dar bāṭen maqṣūd eʿlā-ye ʿolovv va somovv-e khodeshān būd, va-lāken dar ẓāher be-\[corrupted text\] eshāre mīnamūdand, gāhī Jābolqā va hengāmī Jābolsā va vaqtī nāḥiye-ye kedhbe ke be-moqaddase mīnāmīdand. Solṭān-e lā yazālī rā ke Noqṭe-ye Bayān, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, dar dhekrash mīfarmāyad, qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu: “Innahu ajallu wa-aʿlā min an yakūna maʿrūfan bi-dūnihi aw mustashīran bi-ishārati khalqihi.”
:::

::: {.translation}
There have always been people like those who turn away. If anyone reflects on the events following the passing of His Holiness ʿAskari, upon him be the peace of God, and on the intrigues of the godless religious scholars, he will testify that all the corruption in the world has come, and continues to come, from such people. By the life of our Lord! Were it not for the lies of the leaders, the Most Exalted Lord would not have been martyred through the oppression of His enemies. They appointed an imaginary personage to an imaginary throne and, through imaginary traditions, established what led to the shedding of the blood of the Lord of the world and the jewels of the nations. At times they produced forged rescripts and attributed them to the Source of existence. Indeed, may God's curse rest upon the people who lie! Inwardly, their aim was to enhance their own eminence and exaltation, but outwardly they pointed to \[corrupted original text\]—sometimes Jabulqa, sometimes Jabulsa, and sometimes the lying seat that they called holy. As for the everlasting Sovereign, the Point of the Bayan—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—says concerning Him, exalted be His remembrance: “He is too glorious and exalted to be known through anyone other than Himself or to seek counsel through the indications of His creatures.”
:::

### 30

::: {.original lang="ar"}
حال نفوس غافله بر اعراض قیام نموده‌اند و بقول این و آن تمسّک جسته‌اند امروز لسان عظمت میفرماید قوله عزّ اجلاله ان یا قلم هل تری الیوم غیری این الأشیآء و ظهوراتها و این الأسمآء و ملکوتها و البواطن و اسرارها و الظّواهر و آثارها قد اخذ الفنآء من فی الانشآء و هذا وجهی الباقی المشرق المنیر انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥāl nofūs-e ghāfele bar eʿrāż qiyām namūde-and va be-qawl-e īn va ān tamassok joste-and. Emrūz Lesān-e ʿAẓamat mīfarmāyad, qawluhu ʿazza ijlāluhu: “An yā qalamu, hal tarā al-yawma ghayrī? Ayna al-ashyāʾu wa-ẓuhūrātuhā, wa-ayna al-asmāʾu wa-malakūtuhā, wa-al-bawāṭinu wa-asrāruhā, wa-al-ẓawāhiru wa-āthāruhā? Qad akhadha al-fanāʾu man fī al-inshāʾi, wa-hādhā wajhī al-bāqī al-mushriqu al-munīr.” Entahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Now heedless souls have arisen in opposition and have clung to the words of this person and that. Today the Tongue of Grandeur declares, exalted be His majesty: “O Pen, do you see anyone but Me today? Where are all things and their manifestations? Where are the names and their kingdom, the inward realities and their mysteries, the outward forms and their effects? Annihilation has overtaken all who dwell in creation, and this is My everlasting, radiant, luminous Face.” End of quotation.
:::

### 31

::: {.original lang="ar"}
حال ملاحظه نمائید بچه متشبّثند و بچه حبال متمسّک اراده دارند یک اسباب موهومهٴ جدیده‌ئی مثل اوهامات قبل از برای ناس بیچاره برپا نمایند مکرّر عرض مینمایم اعاذنا اللّه یا معشر الموحّدین من شرّ هؤلآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥāl molāḥeẓe namāyīd be-che motashabbethand va be-che ḥebāl motamassek. Erāde dārand yek asbāb-e mawhūme-ye jadīdeʾī methl-e awhāmāt-e qabl az barā-ye nās-e bīchāre barpā namāyand. Mokarrar ʿarż mīnamāyam: “Aʿādhanā Allāhu, yā maʿshara al-muwaḥḥidīn, min sharri hāʾulāʾ.”
:::

::: {.translation}
Now consider what they cling to and what cords they grasp. They intend to set up a new imaginary apparatus for the helpless people, like the vain imaginings of the past. Again I say: “May God protect us, O company of those who affirm His oneness, from the evil of these people.”
:::

### 32

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری الیوم هیچ کتابی از کتب و هیچ لوحی از الواح و هیچ صحیفه‌ئی از صحف کفایت نمینماید سبحان‌اللّه عمّا یقولون الظّالمون الیوم کلّ باید بافق ظهور و ما یظهر من عنده ناظر باشند اگر به اوهامات و ظنونات و روایات انسان مشغول شود البتّه عاقبت آن بر هلاکت است چنانچه دیده شد
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bārī al-yawm hīch ketābī az kotob va hīch lawḥī az alvāḥ va hīch ṣaḥīfeʾī az ṣoḥof kefāyat nemīnamāyad. Subḥāna Allāhi ʿammā yaqūlu al-ẓālimūn. Al-yawm koll bāyad be-ofoq-e ẓohūr va mā yaẓharu min ʿindihi nāẓer bāshand. Agar be-awhāmāt va ẓonūnāt va revāyāt ensān mashghūl shavad, albatte ʿāqebat-e ān bar halākat ast, chenānche dīde shod.
:::

::: {.translation}
In short, today no book among the books, no tablet among the tablets, and no scripture among the scriptures suffices. Glorified be God above what the wrongdoers say! Today all must look toward the horizon of the Revelation and whatever appears from Him. If a person occupies himself with vain imaginings, conjectures, and traditions, his end will assuredly be destruction, as has been seen.
:::

### 33

::: {.original lang="ar"}
سبحانک یا اله البرّ و البحر ترانی قائماً بین یدیک و ایادی رجای مرتفعة الی سمآء جودک و فضلک اسئلک بسلطانک المهیمن علی الکائنات و اسمک الّذی به سخّرت الممکنات بأن تؤیّد عبادک علی العدل و الانصاف و وفّقهم علی التّوجّه الیک ببصرک و النّظر الی شطرک بنورک انت الّذی باسمک ماجت بحور الفضل و العطآء و بمشیّتک تزیّنت سمآء کرمک یا مالک الأسمآء لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المختار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Subḥānaka yā Ilāha al-barri wa-al-baḥr. Tarānī qāʾiman bayna yadayka wa-ayādī rajāya murtafiʿatan ilā samāʾi jūdika wa-faḍlika. Asʾaluka bi-sulṭānika al-muhaymini ʿalā al-kāʾināti wa-ismika alladhī bihi sakhkharta al-mumkināti bi-an tuʾayyida ʿibādaka ʿalā al-ʿadli wa-al-inṣāfi wa-waffiqhum ʿalā al-tawajjuhi ilayka bi-baṣarika wa-al-naẓari ilā shaṭrika bi-nūrika. Anta alladhī bi-ismika mājat buḥūru al-faḍli wa-al-ʿaṭāʾi wa-bi-mashīʾatika tazayyanat samāʾu karamika yā Mālika al-asmāʾ. Lā ilāha illā Anta al-Muqtadiru al-Mukhtār.
:::

::: {.translation}
Glory be to You, O God of land and sea! You see me standing before You, with the hands of my hope raised toward the heaven of Your bounty and grace. I ask You, by Your sovereignty that overshadows all created things and by Your name through which You have subdued all contingent beings, to aid Your servants to act with justice and fairness. Enable them to turn toward You with Your sight and to look in Your direction through Your light. You are the One through whose name the seas of grace and bounty have surged, and through whose will the heaven of Your generosity has been adorned, O Lord of Names. There is no God but You, the All-Powerful, who chooses as He wills.
:::

### 34

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اگر الیوم نفسی به غیر حقّ و بیان حقّ ناظر باشد البتّه از صراط منحرف شود و البتّه بسقر مقرّ گیرد میفرماید جمیع بیان ورقی است از اوراق جنّت او اگر بقبول فائز شود سبحان‌اللّه امر در چه مقام و خراطین در چه طین این خادم فانی متحیّر واللّه المهیمن القیّوم از اوّل امر تا حین خیالی جز رضای حقّ نداشته و ندارم حال پیر شده‌ام و قوی ضعیف گشته مع‌ذلک و مع شغل عظیم خالصاً لوجه اللّه باین نوشته مشغول شده‌ام حقّ گواه و آگاه که جز رضایش را طالب نبوده و نیستم لوجهه گفته و لوجهه میگویم من شآء فلیقبل و من شآء فلیعرض انّ ربّنا الرّحمن لهو الغنیّ الحمید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Agar al-yawm nafsī be-ghayr-e Ḥaqq va bayān-e Ḥaqq nāẓer bāshad, albatte az ṣerāṭ monḥaref shavad va albatte be-Saqar maqarr gīrad. Mīfarmāyad: “Jamīʿ-e Bayān varaqī ast az awrāq-e jannat-e ū agar be-qabūl fāʾez shavad.” Subḥāna Allāh, amr dar che maqām va kharāṭīn dar che ṭīn. Īn khādem-e fānī motaḥayyer. Wa-Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm, az avval-e amr tā ḥīn khayālī joz reżā-ye Ḥaqq nadāshte va nadāram. Ḥāl pīr shode-am va qovā żaʿīf gashte. Maʿa dhālek va maʿa shoghl-e ʿaẓīm, khāliṣan li-wajhi Allāh be-īn neveshte mashghūl shode-am. Ḥaqq govāh va āgāh ke joz reżāyash rā ṭāleb nabūde va nīstam. Li-wajhihi gofte va li-wajhihi mīgūyam. Man shāʾa fa-l-yuqbil wa-man shāʾa fa-l-yuʿriḍ. Inna Rabbanā al-Raḥmāna la-huwa al-Ghaniyyu al-Ḥamīd.
:::

::: {.translation}
If today anyone looks to anything other than God and His utterance, he will assuredly stray from the path and assuredly make his abode in hell. He says: “The entire Bayan is but a leaf among the leaves of His paradise, if it attains His acceptance.” Glory be to God! How lofty is the station of the Cause, and in what mud do these earthworms dwell! This mortal servant is bewildered. By God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting! From the beginning of the Cause until now, I have had, and still have, no thought but God's good pleasure. Now I have grown old and my strength has waned. Nevertheless, despite my pressing duties, I have occupied myself with this writing solely for the sake of God. God is witness and knows that I have sought, and still seek, nothing but His good pleasure. For His sake I have spoken, and for His sake I speak. Let whoever wishes turn toward Him, and whoever wishes turn away. Our Lord, the All-Merciful, is indeed the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
:::

### 35

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و همچنین در اینکلمهٴ علیا که از مطلع بیان مالک اسماء یعنی نقطهٴ اولی روح ما سواه فداه نازل شده تفکّر فرمائید و فی‌الحقیقه اینکلمه از جوهر بیان محسوبست قوله تعالی و فی سنة التّسع انتم کلّ خیر تدرکون و فی سنة التّسع انتم بلقآء اللّه ترزقون و مخاطباً لحضرة العظیم علیه من کلّ بهآء ابهاه و من کلّ علآء اعلاه میفرماید قوله تعالی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va hamchenīn dar īn kaleme-ye ʿolyā ke az maṭlaʿ-e bayān-e Mālek-e Asmā, yaʿnī Noqṭe-ye Ūlā, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, nāzel shode tafakkor farmāyīd. Va fī’l-ḥaqīqe īn kaleme az jawhar-e bayān maḥsūb ast. Qawluhu taʿālā: “Wa-fī sanati al-tisʿi antum kulla khayrin tudrikūn, wa-fī sanati al-tisʿi antum bi-liqāʾi Allāhi turzaqūn.” Va mokhāṭaban le-Ḥażrat-e ʿAẓīm, ʿalayhi min kulli bahāʾin abhāhu wa-min kulli ʿalāʾin aʿlāhu, mīfarmāyad, qawluhu taʿālā:
:::

::: {.translation}
Reflect also on this exalted utterance revealed from the Dayspring of the utterance of the Lord of Names, namely the Primal Point—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him. In truth, this utterance is to be counted among the very essence of His words. He, exalted be He, says: “In the year nine you will attain all good, and in the year nine you will be granted the presence of God.” And, addressing His Honor ʿAzim—upon him be the most resplendent of all glory and the loftiest of all exaltation—He, exalted be He, says:
:::

### 36

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هذا ما قد وعدناک قبل حین الّذی اجبناک اصبر حتّی یقضی عن البیان تسعةً فاذا قل فتبارک اللّه احسن المبدعین حال انصاف دهید در سنهٴ تسع کِه ظاهر شد این الآذان و این الأبصار باری مفرّی از برای احدی نبوده و نیست الّا ان یتوب و یرجع الی اللّه المهیمن القیّوم مگر از سماء برهان و شمس ایقان و بحر اعظم و نبأ عظیم چشم پوشد از برای چنین نفسی آیات الهی و بیّنات ربّانی ثمری نداشته و ندارد هر صاحب انصافی شهادت میدهد که امر اللّه باین ظهور اعظم ظاهر در ایّامیکه جمیع بحفظ جان مشغول و در زاویها مستور و محجوب حقّ جلّ جلاله بنفسه قائم و ناطق چنانچه رشحات بحر بیانش عالم را اخذ نموده و آثارش آفاق را احاطه فرموده طوبی از برای منصفین و سامعین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
“Hādhā mā qad waʿadnāka qablu ḥīna alladhī ajabnāka. Iṣbir ḥattā yuqḍā ʿani al-Bayāni tisʿatan, fa-idhā qul fa-tabāraka Allāhu aḥsanu al-mubdiʿīn.” Ḥāl enṣāf dahīd, dar sane-ye tesʿ keh ẓāher shod? Ayna al-ādhānu wa-ayna al-abṣār? Bārī mafarrī az barā-ye aḥadī nabūde va nīst illā an yatūba wa-yarjiʿa ilā Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm, magar az samā-ye borhān va shams-e īqān va baḥr-e aʿẓam va nabaʾ-e ʿaẓīm chashm pūshad. Az barā-ye chonīn nafsī āyāt-e elāhī va bayyenāt-e rabbānī thamarī nadāshte va nadārad. Har ṣāḥeb-e enṣāfī shahādat mīdahad ke Amr Allāh be-īn ẓohūr-e aʿẓam ẓāher. Dar ayyāmī ke jamīʿ be-ḥefẓ-e jān mashghūl va dar zāviyehā mastūr va maḥjūb, Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, be-nafsehe qāʾem va nāṭeq, chenānche rashaḥāt-e baḥr-e bayānash ʿālam rā akhdh namūde va āthārash āfāq rā eḥāṭe farmūde. Ṭūbā az barā-ye monṣefīn va sāmeʿīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
“This is what We promised you before, at the time when We answered you. Be patient until nine have elapsed from the Bayan; then say: ‘Blessed be God, the best of originators!’” Now judge fairly: who appeared in the year nine? Where are the ears, and where are the eyes? In short, there has never been, nor is there now, any refuge for anyone except to repent and return to God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, unless he shuts his eyes to the heaven of proof, the sun of certitude, the Most Great Ocean, and the momentous Announcement. For such a person the divine verses and the Lord's clear proofs have been, and remain, fruitless. Every fair-minded person testifies that the Cause of God is manifest through this Most Great Revelation. In the days when all were occupied with preserving their lives and were concealed and hidden in corners, God, exalted be His glory, stood forth and spoke in His own Person, so that the spray from the ocean of His utterance has encompassed the world and His writings have embraced every horizon. Blessed are the fair-minded and those who listen.
:::

### 37

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و همچنین نقطهٴ اولی روح ما سواه فداه میفرماید قل هو نبأ لم یحیط بعلمه احد الّا اللّه ولکن انتم یومئذ لا تعلمون مع‌ذلک این قوم بی‌انصاف گفته‌اند آنچه گفته‌اند این آن نبأ عظیمی است که در جمیع کتب مذکور و مسطور است و احدی جز نفس حقّ بر حین ظهور مطّلع نه و آگاه نه اینست آن ساعتیکه حضرت روح میفرماید و از او اخبار نموده و امّا ذلک الیوم و تلک السّاعة فلا یعلم بهما احداً و لا الملائکة الّذین فی السّمآء و لا الابن الّا الأب انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va hamchenīn Noqṭe-ye Ūlā, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, mīfarmāyad: “Qul huwa nabaʾun lam yuḥiṭ bi-ʿilmihi aḥadun illā Allāhu wa-lākin antum yawmaʾidhin lā taʿlamūn.” Maʿa dhālek īn qawm-e bī-enṣāf gofte-and ānche gofte-and. Īn ān nabaʾ-e ʿaẓīmī ast ke dar jamīʿ-e kotob madhkūr va masṭūr ast va aḥadī joz nafs-e Ḥaqq bar ḥīn-e ẓohūr moṭṭaleʿ na va āgāh na. Īn ast ān sāʿatī ke Ḥażrat-e Rūḥ mīfarmāyad va az ū ekhbār namūde: “Wa-ammā dhālika al-yawmu wa-tilka al-sāʿatu fa-lā yaʿlamu bihimā aḥadan wa-lā al-malāʾikatu alladhīna fī al-samāʾi wa-lā al-ibnu illā al-ab.” Entahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Likewise, the Primal Point—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—says: “Say: It is an announcement whose knowledge none but God has encompassed, yet on that day you will not know.” Despite this, these unfair people have said what they have said. This is that momentous Announcement mentioned and recorded in all the books, and no one but God Himself knows or is aware of the time of its appearance. This is the hour of which Jesus speaks and which He foretold: “But of that day and that hour no one knows, neither the angels in heaven nor the Son, but only the Father.” End of quotation.
:::

### 38

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینست آن یومیکه حضرت یوئیل در کتاب خود میفرماید لأنّ یوم الرّبّ عظیم و مخوف جدّاً فمن یطیقه و همچنین حضرت ارمیا میفرماید آه لأنّ ذلک الیوم عظیم و لیس مثله جمیع آنچه ظاهر شده در کتب مرسلین مذکور حتّی ذکر حصن که حال مقرّ عرش است و به سجن اعظم موسوم چنانچه داود میفرماید من یقودنی الی المدینة المحصّنه و مدینهٴ محصّنه عکّاست و حصنش معروف و مشهور اینست آن حصنیکه میفرماید انوار آفتاب حقیقت بر او تجلّی فرموده و از افقش اشراق کرده و همچنین بشارت داده‌اند یکدیگر و عباد این ارض را که حقّ در آخر ایّام در این اراضی ظاهر میشود و تجلّی میفرماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn ast ān yawmī ke Ḥażrat-e Yūʾīl dar ketāb-e khod mīfarmāyad: “Li-anna yawma al-Rabbi ʿaẓīmun wa-makhūfun jiddan fa-man yuṭīquhu?” Va hamchenīn Ḥażrat-e Ermiyā mīfarmāyad: “Āh, li-anna dhālika al-yawma ʿaẓīmun wa-laysa mithluhu.” Jamīʿ-e ānche ẓāher shode dar kotob-e morsalīn madhkūr, ḥattā dhekr-e ḥeṣn ke ḥāl maqarr-e ʿarsh ast va be-Sejn-e Aʿẓam mawsūm, chenānche Dāvūd mīfarmāyad: “Man yaqūdunī ilā al-madīnati al-muḥaṣṣana?” Va madīne-ye moḥaṣṣane ʿAkkā-st va ḥeṣnash maʿrūf va mashhūr. Īn ast ān ḥeṣnī ke mīfarmāyad anvār-e Āftāb-e Ḥaqīqat bar ū tajallī farmūde va az ofoqash eshrāq karde. Va hamchenīn beshārat dāde-and yekdīgar va ʿebād-e īn arż rā ke Ḥaqq dar ākhar-e ayyām dar īn arāżī ẓāher mīshavad va tajallī mīfarmāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
And this is the day of which Joel says in his book: “For the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; who can endure it?” Likewise Jeremiah says: “Alas, for that day is great, and none is like it.” Everything that has appeared is mentioned in the books of the Messengers, even the fortress that is now the seat of the throne and is called the Most Great Prison, as David says: “Who will lead me into the fortified city?” The fortified city is Akka, and its fortress is well known and renowned. This is the fortress of which he says that the lights of the Sun of Truth have shone upon it and risen from its horizon. Likewise, they gave one another and the inhabitants of this land the glad tidings that God would appear and reveal His splendor in these lands in the last days.
:::

### 39

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حضرت اشعیا میفرماید علی جبل عال اصعدی یا مبشّرة صهیون ارفعی صوتک بقوّة یا مبشّرة اورشلیم ارفعی لا تخافی قولی لمدن یهوذا هو ذا الهک هو ذا السّیّد الرّبّ بقوّة یأتی و ذراعة تحکم له صهیون و اورشلیم در این اراضی است و میفرماید باسم جدید نامیده میشود چنانچه در ارض سرّ از لسان عظمت بواد النّبیل موسوم گشته و اینست آن وادی که نداء جمیع انبیا در او مرتفع و به لبّیک اللّهمّ لبّیک ناطق حضرت خلیل و کلیم و روح و خاتم انبیا روح من فی الوجود فداهم در این اراضی ظاهر چه که این ارض بارض بطحا و حجاز متّصل میشود اینست که میفرماید طوبی لمن هاجر الی عکّا قسم بآفتاب افق بیان که مقصود اینفانی اظهار علم و فضل و اطّلاع نبوده و نیست بلکه لوجه اللّه عرض میشود که نفوس غافله سبب احتجاب خلق نشوند چنانچه از قبل شده‌اند باری اینست اراضی مقدّسه که در فرقان و کتب قبل مذکور و در کتاب عاموس نبی (ع) میفرماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥażrat-e Eshʿiyā mīfarmāyad: “ʿAlā jabalin ʿālin iṣʿadī yā mubashshirata Ṣahyūn. Irfaʿī ṣawtaki bi-quwwatin yā mubashshirata Ūrashalīm. Irfaʿī lā takhāfī. Qūlī li-muduni Yahūdhā: Huwa dhā Ilāhuki. Huwa dhā al-Sayyidu al-Rabbu bi-quwwatin yaʾtī wa-dhirāʿuhu taḥkumu lahu.” Ṣahyūn va Ūrashalīm dar īn arāżī ast va mīfarmāyad be-esm-e jadīd nāmīde mīshavad, chenānche dar Arż-e Serr az Lesān-e ʿAẓamat be-Vād-e Nabīl mawsūm gashte. Va īn ast ān vādī ke nedā-ye jamīʿ-e anbiyā dar ū mortafeʿ va be-“Labbayka Allāhumma labbayk” nāṭeq. Ḥażrat-e Khalīl va Kalīm va Rūḥ va Khātam-e Anbiyā, rūḥ-e man fī al-vojūd fedāhom, dar īn arāżī ẓāher, che ke īn arż be-arż-e Baṭḥā va Ḥejāz mottaṣel mīshavad. Īn ast ke mīfarmāyad: “Ṭūbā li-man hājara ilā ʿAkkā.” Qasam be-Āftāb-e ofoq-e bayān ke maqṣūd-e īn fānī eẓhār-e ʿelm va fażl va eṭṭelāʿ nabūde va nīst, balke li-wajhi Allāh ʿarż mīshavad ke nofūs-e ghāfele sabab-e eḥtejāb-e khalq nashavand, chenānche az qabl shode-and. Bārī īn ast arāżī-ye moqaddase ke dar Forqān va kotob-e qabl madhkūr, va dar ketāb-e ʿĀmūs-e Nabī, ʿalayhi al-salām, mīfarmāyad:
:::

::: {.translation}
Isaiah says: “Go up onto a high mountain, O herald of Zion. Lift up your voice with strength, O herald of Jerusalem. Lift it up, do not fear. Say to the cities of Judah: ‘Behold your God! Behold, the Lord God comes with power, and His arm rules for Him.’” Zion and Jerusalem are in these lands, and he says that it will be called by a new name, just as in the Land of Mystery it was named the Noble Valley by the Tongue of Grandeur. This is the valley in which the call of all the Prophets is raised and which proclaims: “Here I am, O God, here I am!” Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and the Seal of the Prophets—may the spirit of all who exist be sacrificed for them—appeared in these lands, for this land is connected to the land of Batha and the Hijaz. Thus He says: “Blessed is whoever migrates to Akka.” I swear by the Sun of the horizon of utterance that this mortal one's purpose has never been, nor is it now, to display knowledge, learning, or erudition. Rather, these things are set forth for the sake of God, so that heedless souls may not cause the people to be veiled, as they have done before. In short, these are the holy lands mentioned in the Quran and the earlier books, and in the book of the Prophet Amos, peace be upon him, he says:
:::

### 40

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انّ الرّبّ یزمجر من صهیون و یعطی صوته من اورشلیم فتنوح مراعی الرّعاة و یبلبس رأس الکرمل و این کرمل مقابل عکّا واقع و در کتب قبل بکَوْم اللّه موسوم و ذکر آن از قلم اعلی جاری البتّه بعضی بآن فائز شده‌اند و از جمله امور محتومه‌ای که باید خباء مجد بر او مرتفع شود و للّه الحمد مرتفع شد و از صهیون فرات معانی جاری رغماً لمن نبذ الانصاف و اخذ الاعتساف
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Inna al-Rabba yuzamjiru min Ṣahyūn wa-yuʿṭī ṣawtahu min Ūrushalīm fa-tanūḥu marāʿī al-ruʿāt wa-\[corrupted text\] raʾs al-Karmil va īn Karmil muqābil-i ʿAkkā vāqiʿ va dar kutub-i qabl be-Kawm-i Allāh mawsūm va dhikr-i ān az Qalam-i Aʿlā jārī albatteh baʿḍī be-ān fāʾiz shodeh-and va az jumleh umūr-i maḥtūmeh-ī keh bāyad khibā-yi majd bar ū murtafiʿ shavad va li-llāh al-ḥamd murtafiʿ shod va az Ṣahyūn Furāt-i maʿānī jārī raghman li-man nabadha al-inṣāf wa-akhadha al-iʿtisāf.
:::

::: {.translation}
“The Lord roars from Zion and gives forth His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and \[corrupted original text\] the summit of Carmel.” This Carmel lies opposite Akka and is called the Mound of God in the earlier books. Its mention has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen, and some have surely attained it. Among the things irrevocably ordained is that the tabernacle of glory should be raised upon it, and, praise be to God, it has been raised. From Zion flows the Euphrates of meanings, despite those who have cast aside fairness and embraced injustice.
:::

### 41

::: {.original lang="fa"}
عظمت ظهور بمقامیست که حضرت داود در ذکرش میفرماید علوّا الرّبّ الهنا و اسجدوا عند موطیء قدمیه قدّوس هو موسی و هرون بین کهنته و صموئیل بین الّذین یدّعون باسمه حال باید در این آیهٴ مبارکه بسیار تفکّر نمود امروز جمیع اشجار منجذب و صخور و احجار مهتزّ و متحرّک و جبال از فرح اکبر در مرور چه که ساعة موعود آمده و مکنون مخزون ظاهر گشته اگر این کلمهٴ علیا از کتب برداشته شود دیگر بیانی باقی نه و ذکری مشهود نه لکن این بیان از برای متبصّرین و عارفین است نه از برای هر همج رعاعی که قائد اوهام و ظنون است
:::

::: {.transliteration}
ʿAẓamat-i ẓuhūr be-maqāmīst keh Ḥaḍrat-i Dāvūd dar dhikrash mī-farmāyad ʿAllū al-Rabba ilāhanā wa-usjudū ʿinda mawṭiʾ qadamayhi quddūsun huwa Mūsā wa-Hārūn bayna kahanatihi wa-Ṣamūʾīl bayna alladhīna yadʿūna bi-ismihi ḥāl bāyad dar īn āyeh-yi mubārakeh bisyār tafakkur namūd imrūz jamīʿ-i ashjār munjadh ib va ṣukhūr va aḥjār muhtazz va mutaḥarrik va jibāl az faraḥ-i akbar dar murūr cheh keh sāʿat-i mawʿūd āmadeh va maknūn-i makhzūn ẓāhir gashteh agar īn kalameh-yi ʿulyā az kutub bardāshteh shavad dīgar bayānī bāqī nah va dhikrī mashhūd nah lākin īn bayān az barā-yi mutabaṣṣirīn va ʿārifīn ast nah az barā-yi har hamaj-i raʿāʿī keh qāʾid-i awhām va ẓunūn ast.
:::

::: {.translation}
The greatness of the Revelation is such that David says in speaking of it: “Exalt the Lord our God and bow down at His footstool. Holy is He. Moses and Aaron are among His priests, and Samuel among those who call upon His name.” Now one must reflect deeply upon this blessed verse. Today all trees are enraptured, rocks and stones tremble and move, and the mountains pass along in the greatest joy, for the promised hour has come and the hidden treasure has been revealed. If this sublime word were removed from the books, no utterance would remain and no mention would be found. But this statement is for those endowed with insight and understanding, not for every base and ignorant person who leads the way in vain imaginings and conjectures.
:::

### 42

::: {.original lang="fa"}
امروز آفتاب یقین اشراق نموده روز دیگر است و ایّام دیگر لا تقاس بغیرها ولکن ابصار مریض و مرمود و آذان مسدود از حقّ میطلبم فرح عطا فرماید و خلق را از این فرح اعظم محروم نسازد و همچنین میفرماید یأتی الیهنا و لا یصمت
:::

::: {.transliteration}
