I will go and ask in the Most Holy Court that He come, so that truth may be clearly and conclusively distinguished from falsehood.” It was agreed that this should take place in the Mosque of Sulṭān Salīm.
:::

### 200

::: {.original lang="fa"}
میر مذکور وارد و تفصیل را نزد بعضی از دوستان ذکر نمود تا آنکه در پیشگاه حضور عرض شد این فانی آن حین حاضر نبود بمجرد اصغا جمال قدم از مقر بر خاستند و فردا واحدا متوجها علی مقر المعلوم توجه فرمودند و در عرض راه بشأنی فرات آیات الهی جاری و نازل که احدی قادر بر وصف آن نه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Mīr-e madhkūr vāred va tafṣīl rā nazd-e baʿḍī az dūstān dhekr namūd tā ānke dar pīshgāh-e ḥuḍūr ʿarḍ shod īn fānī ān ḥīn ḥāḍer nabūd be-mojarrad-e eṣghā Jamāl-e Qedam az maqarr bar khāstand va fardan wāḥidan mutawajjihan ʿalā maqarri al-maʿlūm tavajjoh farmūdand va dar ʿarḍ-e rāh be-shaʾnī Forāt-e āyāt-e elāhī jārī va nāzel ke aḥadī qāder bar vaṣf-e ān na.
:::

::: {.translation}
The aforementioned Mīr arrived and related the details to some of the friends, until the matter was submitted in His presence. This transitory servant was not present at that moment. As soon as He heard it, the Ancient Beauty rose from His seat and, alone and unaccompanied, set out toward the appointed place. Along the way, the Euphrates of divine verses flowed and descended in such a manner that no one could describe it.
:::

### 201

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و این عبد در آن حین در سوق بوده بجهة تمشیت بعض امور بیت بعد از استماع بسرعت تمام توجه نمودم در اثنای راه ملاحظه شد جمعی اهل بلد از طرفین معبر متحیر ایستاده‌اند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn ʿabd dar ān ḥīn dar sūq būde be-jehat-e tamshīyat-e baʿḍ-e omūr-e bayt baʿd az estemāʿ be-sorʿat-e tamām tavajjoh namūdam dar athnā-ye rāh molāḥaẓe shod jamʿī ahl-e balad az ṭarafayn-e maʿbar motaḥayyer īstāde-and.
:::

::: {.translation}
At that moment this servant was in the market attending to some household affairs. After hearing the news, I set out with all speed. Along the way, I saw a group of townspeople standing in astonishment on both sides of the road.
:::

### 202

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این عبد را که دیدند با دست اشاره نمودند یعنی از این سمت تشریف بردند تا اینکه این عبد وارد جامع شد مشاهده نمود بحر آیات مواج لعمر مقصودی و مقصود من فی السموات و الارض بشأنی آیات نازل که کل متحیر که آیا چه واقع شده یکی از اعجام مشاهده شد که میلرزید و میگریست و در حضور از اصحاب جز میر محمد و این عبد که از بعد رسید احدی حاضر نه چه که کل را از حضور نهی فرمودند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn ʿabd rā ke dīdand bā dast eshāre namūdand yaʿnī az īn samt tashrīf bordand tā īnke īn ʿabd vāred-e jāmeʿ shod moshāhede namūd baḥr-e āyāt mavvāj la-ʿamri maqṣūdī wa-maqṣūdi man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍ be-shaʾnī āyāt nāzel ke koll motaḥayyer ke āyā che vāqeʿ shode yekī az aʿjām moshāhede shod ke mīlarzīd va mīgerīst va dar ḥuḍūr az aṣḥāb joz Mīr Muḥammad va īn ʿabd ke az baʿd resīd aḥadī ḥāḍer na che ke koll rā az ḥuḍūr nahy farmūdand.
:::

::: {.translation}
When they saw this servant, they gestured with their hands to indicate, “He went this way.” When this servant entered the congregational mosque, he saw the ocean of verses surging. By the life of Him who is my Desire and the Desire of all in the heavens and on earth! The verses were descending in such a manner that everyone was bewildered, wondering what had happened. One of the Persians was seen trembling and weeping. None of the companions was in His presence except Mīr Muḥammad and this servant, who arrived afterward, for He had forbidden them all to attend.
:::

### 203

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بعد وجه مبارک بمیر محمد متوجه قال یا محمد اذهب الیهم و قل تعالوا بحبالکم و عصیکم میر بسرعت تمام رفت بعد از مراجعت عرض نمود حضرات از گفته نادم شدند و عذر آوردند که امروز ممکن نیست فرمودند بگو تا سه یوم مهلت هر یوم حاضر شوید ما حاضریم بعد ساعتی در جامع بصلوة مشغول یعنی صلاة بدیعی و بعد از مراجعت بمجرد ورود در بیت یک لوح بخط مبارک نازل و بمهر مبارک مختوم که تا سه یوم هر یوم بیائید ما حاضریم و آن لوح رانزد اصحاب فرستادند تا کل مطلع باشند و جناب میر هم رفت و تفصیل لوح را اخبار نمود ولکن از آن نفوس اثری ظاهر نشد
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Baʿd vajh-e mobārak be-Mīr Muḥammad motavajjeh qāla yā Muḥammad idhhab ilayhim wa-qul taʿālaw bi-ḥibālikum wa-ʿiṣiyyikum Mīr be-sorʿat-e tamām raft baʿd az morājaʿat ʿarḍ namūd ḥaḍarāt az gofte nādem shodand va ʿodhr āvardand ke emrūz momken nīst farmūdand begū tā se yawm mohlat har yawm ḥāḍer shavīd mā ḥāḍerīm baʿd sāʿatī dar jāmeʿ be-ṣalāt mashghūl yaʿnī ṣalāt-e badīʿī va baʿd az morājaʿat be-mojarrad-e vorūd dar bayt yek lawḥ be-khaṭṭ-e mobārak nāzel va be-mohr-e mobārak makhtūm ke tā se yawm har yawm beyāyīd mā ḥāḍerīm va ān lawḥ rā nazd-e aṣḥāb ferestādand tā koll moṭṭaleʿ bāshand va Janāb-e Mīr ham raft va tafṣīl-e lawḥ rā ekhbār namūd va lāken az ān nufūs atharī ẓāher nashod.
:::

::: {.translation}
Then He turned His blessed face toward Mīr Muḥammad and said, “Muḥammad, go to them and say, ‘Come with your ropes and your rods.’” Mīr went with all speed. On returning, he reported, “The gentlemen have regretted what they said and have offered the excuse that today is not possible.” He said, “Tell them they have three days’ grace. Whichever day you present yourselves, We are ready.” He then spent a while in prayer in the mosque—a wondrous prayer. After returning, as soon as He entered the house, a Tablet was revealed in His own blessed handwriting and sealed with His blessed seal, stating, “Come on any day within three days; We are ready.” He sent that Tablet to the companions so that all would be informed. Mīr also went and conveyed the details of the Tablet, but no sign of those people appeared.
:::

### 204

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ای آقایان تفکر نمائید امر بچه شأن ظاهر و ناس بچه شأن غافل غیر اهل آن مدینه قریب صد نفر از مهاجرین و مسافرین جمع بودند و کل بر این مطلب شاهد و گواه و آن لوح مبارک موجود و سوره مباهله در تفصیل آن یوم نازل و حسب الامر نزد یکی از اولیا ارسال شد که بر احبا و اولیای الهی قرائت نماید و البته اکثری باصغاء آن فائز شده‌اند و بعضی از آن در این مقام ثبت میشود تا امکان از آیات رحمن منور گردد و افئده عالم بطراز عدل و انصاف مزین شود الامر بید اللّه هذا ما نزل من جبروت مشیة ربّنا العزیز العلام قوله جل جلاله ان
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ay āqāyān tafakkor namāyīd amr be-che shaʾn ẓāher va nās be-che shaʾn ghāfel ghayr-e ahl-e ān madīne qarīb-e ṣad nafar az mohājerīn va mosāferīn jamʿ būdand va koll bar īn maṭlab shāhed va govāh va ān lawḥ-e mobārak mawjūd va Sūre-ye Mubāhale dar tafṣīl-e ān yawm nāzel va ḥasb al-amr nazd-e yekī az awliyā ersāl shod ke bar aḥebbā va awliyā-ye elāhī qerāʾat namāyad va albatte aktharī be-eṣghā-ye ān fāʾez shode-and va baʿḍī az ān dar īn maqām thabt mīshavad tā emkān az āyāt-e Raḥmān monavvar gardad va afʾede-ye ʿālam be-ṭerāz-e ʿadl va enṣāf mozayyan shavad al-amru bi-yadi Allāh hādhā mā nazala min jabarūti mashīʾati Rabbinā al-ʿAzīzi al-ʿAllām qawluhu jalla jalāluhu in.
:::

::: {.translation}
Gentlemen, reflect on how manifest the Cause is and how heedless the people are. Apart from the inhabitants of that city, nearly a hundred emigrants and travelers were gathered there, and all bear witness and testify to this matter. That blessed Tablet still exists. The Sūrih of the Mutual Invocation was revealed, detailing that day, and was sent, as instructed, to one of the faithful to read to the loved ones and friends of God. Surely most have had the privilege of hearing it. A portion of it is recorded here, so that the world of existence may be illumined by the verses of the All-Merciful and the hearts of the world adorned with justice and fairness. Authority rests in God’s hand. This is what has descended from the dominion of the will of our Lord, the Almighty, the All-Knowing. His words—exalted be His glory—are: “Indeed,
:::

### 205

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا قلم الاعلی اذکر لاسمک نبا هذه المدینة لیکون من المطلعین اذ جائک محمد من لدی المشرکین و قال انهم ارادوا ان یجتمعوا معک فی مقر آخر فلما سمعنا خرجنا عن البیت بسلطان مبین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Qalama al-Aʿlā udhkur li-ismika nabaʾa hādhihi al-madīnati li-yakūna mina al-muṭṭaliʿīn idh jāʾaka Muḥammadun min ladā al-mushrikīna wa-qāla innahum arādū an yajtamiʿū maʿaka fī maqarrin ākhar fa-lammā samiʿnā kharajnā ʿani al-bayti bi-sulṭānin mubīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Most Exalted Pen, recount to your namesake the news of this city, that he may be informed. When Muḥammad came to you from those who associate partners with God and said, ‘They wish to meet with You in another place,’ We left the house with manifest authority as soon as We heard.
:::

### 206

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و قلنا یا محمد خرج الروح من مقره و خرجت معه ارواح الاصفیاء ثمّ حقایق المرسلین انظر لتری الملأ الاعلی فوق رأسی و فی قبضتی حجج النبیین افتح عینک هذا علی ثمّ محمد رسول اللّه قد طلع من افق البیت بسلطان مبین قل انه اتی برایات الایات من لدی اللّه المقتدر القدیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-qulnā yā Muḥammad kharaja al-rūḥu min maqarrihi wa-kharajat maʿahu arwāḥu al-aṣfiyāʾ thumma ḥaqāʾiqu al-mursalīn unẓur li-tarā al-malaʾa al-aʿlā fawqa raʾsī wa-fī qabḍatī ḥujaju al-nabiyyīn iftaḥ ʿaynaka hādhā ʿAliyyun thumma Muḥammadun Rasūlu Allāh qad ṭalaʿa min ufuqi al-bayti bi-sulṭānin mubīn qul innahu atā bi-rāyāti al-āyāti min ladā Allāhi al-Muqtadiri al-Qadīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
And We said, ‘Muḥammad, the Spirit has left His dwelling, and with Him have come forth the souls of the chosen ones and the realities of the Messengers. Look, that you may see the Concourse on High above My head, while in My grasp are the proofs of the Prophets. Open your eyes: this is ʿAlī, and then Muḥammad, the Messenger of God, who has appeared above the horizon of the house with manifest authority. Say: He has come with the banners of the verses from God, the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.’
:::

### 207

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل لو اجتمع من علی الارض من العلماء و العرفأ ثم الملوک و السلاطین انّی احضر امام وجوههم ناطقا آیات اللّه الملک العزیز الحکیم انا الذی لا اخاف من احد لو یجتمع علی ضری من فی السموات و الارضین قد خضعت الایات لوجهی و خشعت الاصوات لندائی العزیز البدیع
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul law ijtamaʿa man ʿalā al-arḍi mina al-ʿulamāʾi wa-al-ʿurafāʾ thumma al-mulūki wa-al-salāṭīn innī aḥḍuru amāma wujūhihim nāṭiqan āyāti Allāhi al-Maliki al-ʿAzīzi al-Ḥakīm anā alladhī lā akhāfu min aḥadin law yajtamiʿu ʿalā ḍurrī man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍīn qad khaḍaʿati al-āyātu li-wajhī wa-khashaʿati al-aṣwātu li-nidāʾī al-ʿAzīzi al-Badīʿ.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: Were all the learned and the mystics on earth, and then the kings and sovereigns, to gather together, I would appear before them, proclaiming the verses of God, the King, the Almighty, the All-Wise. I am He who fears no one, even if all in the heavens and the earths should unite to harm Me. The verses have bowed before My face, and voices have been hushed before My mighty, wondrous call.
:::

### 208

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل هذه یدی قد جعلها اللّه بیضاء للناظرین و هی عصای لو نلقیها لتبلع الارض و من علیها و انا العلیم الخبیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul hādhihi yadī qad jaʿalahā Allāhu bayḍāʾa li-al-nāẓirīn wa-hiya ʿaṣāya law nulqīhā li-tablaʿa al-arḍa wa-man ʿalayhā wa-anā al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: This is My hand, which God has made white for all to behold, and it is My rod: were We to cast it down, it would swallow the earth and all who are upon it. I am the All-Knowing, the All-Aware.
:::

### 209

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا محمد اذهب الی المشرکین برسالات اللّه رب العالمین قل قد جائکم الغلام و معه جنود الوحی و الالهام یمشی امامه الملکوت و عن ورائه قبائل الملأ الاعلی و اهل مدائن الاسماء ثمّ ملائکة المقربون
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Muḥammad idhhab ilā al-mushrikīna bi-risālāti Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn qul qad jāʾakumu al-ghulāmu wa-maʿahu junūdu al-waḥyi wa-al-ilhām yamshī amāmahu al-malakūtu wa-ʿan warāʾihi qabāʾilu al-malaʾi al-aʿlā wa-ahlu madāʾini al-asmāʾ thumma malāʾikatu al-muqarrabūn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Muḥammad, go to those who associate partners with God with the messages of God, the Lord of the worlds. Say: The Youth has come to you, and with Him are the hosts of revelation and inspiration. The Kingdom walks before Him, and behind Him are the tribes of the Concourse on High, the inhabitants of the cities of names, and the angels who are brought near.
:::

### 210

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل خافوا اللّه و لا تعترضوا علی الذی بامره قدر کل امر حکیم قل تعالوا بحبالکم و عصیکم و ما عندکم لو انتم من القادرین انا نذهب الی بیت اللّه الذی بناه احد من الملوک وسمی بالسلیم و اتوقف هناک الی ان تغرب الشمس فی مغربها لیتم علیهم حجة اللّه و برهانه و یکونن من التائبین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul khāfū Allāha wa-lā taʿtariḍū ʿalā alladhī bi-amrihi quddira kullu amrin ḥakīm qul taʿālaw bi-ḥibālikum wa-ʿiṣiyyikum wa-mā ʿindakum law antum mina al-qādirīn anā nadhhabu ilā bayti Allāhi alladhī banāhu aḥadun mina al-mulūki wa-summiya bi-al-Salīm wa-atawaqqafu hunāka ilā an taghruba al-shamsu fī maghribihā li-yatimma ʿalayhim ḥujjatu Allāhi wa-burhānuhu wa-yakūnanna mina al-tāʾibīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: Fear God, and do not oppose Him by whose command every wise decree has been ordained. Say: Come with your ropes, your rods, and whatever you possess, if you are able. We are going to the house of God which one of the kings built and which is called Salīm, and I shall remain there until the sun sets in its place of setting, so that God’s proof and demonstration may be made complete for them and they may be among those who repent.
:::

### 211

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل قد انقطعت الیوم نسبة کل ذی نسبة الّا من دخل فی ظل هذا الامر المشرق المنیر من تمسک باسم من الاسماء معرضا عن موجدها انه لیس منی و کان اللّه بریئا منه انا خلقنا الاسماء کخلق کل شئ ان انتم من العارفین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul qad inqaṭaʿati al-yawma nisbatu kulli dhī nisbatin illā man dakhala fī ẓilli hādhā al-amri al-mushriqi al-munīr man tamassaka bi-ismin mina al-asmāʾi muʿriḍan ʿan mūjidihā innahu laysa minnī wa-kāna Allāhu barīʾan minhu anā khalaqnā al-asmāʾa ka-khalqi kulli shayʾin in antum mina al-ʿārifīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: Today every bond of affiliation has been severed, except for those who have entered beneath the shadow of this radiant, luminous Cause. Whoever clings to any name while turning away from the One who brought the names into being is not of Me, and God disavows him. We created the names just as We created all things, if you are among those who understand.
:::

### 212

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل انّی قد اظهرت نفسی لله و خرجت لله و اتکلم امام من علی الارض کما اتکلم امام وجهک الا اخاف من احد یشهد بذلک عملی لو انت من العارفین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul innī qad aẓhartu nafsī li-llāhi wa-kharajtu li-llāhi wa-atakallamu amāma man ʿalā al-arḍi kamā atakallamu amāma wajhika alā akhāfu min aḥadin yashhadu bi-dhālika ʿamalī law anta mina al-ʿārifīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: I have manifested Myself for God, and I have come forth for God. I speak before all who are on earth just as I speak before you. Truly, I fear no one. My actions bear witness to this, if you are among those who understand.
:::

### 213

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل ان آثار الحق ظاهرة کضیاء الشمس و انوارها تاللّه انها اظهر عند کل ذی بصر حدید هل تظن دونه یقدر ان یقوم معه لا و نفسه العلی العظیم ان الذی اعتکفوا علی الاسماء اولئک من عبدة الاصنام لو انت من الشاهدین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul inna āthāra al-Ḥaqqi ẓāhiratun ka-ḍiyāʾi al-shamsi wa-anwārihā ta-Allāhi innahā aẓharu ʿinda kulli dhī baṣarin ḥadīd hal taẓunnu dūnahu yaqdiru an yaqūma maʿahu lā wa-nafsihi al-ʿAliyyi al-ʿAẓīm inna alladhī iʿtakafū ʿalā al-asmāʾi ulāʾika min ʿabadati al-aṣnāmi law anta mina al-shāhidīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: The signs of the True One are as manifest as the sun’s radiance and light. By God, they are even more manifest to everyone with keen sight. Do you imagine that anyone besides Him can stand alongside Him? No, by His own exalted and mighty Self! Those who have devoted themselves to names are worshippers of idols, if you are among those who see.
:::

### 214

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ان النبی من اخبر الناس بهذا النبأ الاقوم الاقدم القدیم و الرسول من بلغ رسالاتی و هدی الذین ضلوا السبیل و الامام من قام امام وجهی بخضوع مبین و الولی من استحصن فی حصن ولایتی المحکم المتین و الوصی من وصی النّاس بما اتاه فی لوح حفیظ
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Inna al-nabiyya man akhbara al-nāsa bi-hādhā al-nabaʾi al-aqwami al-aqdami al-qadīm wa-al-rasūlu man ballagha risālātī wa-hadā alladhīna ḍallū al-sabīl wa-al-imāmu man qāma amāma wajhī bi-khuḍūʿin mubīn wa-al-waliyyu man istaḥṣana fī ḥiṣni wilāyatī al-muḥkami al-matīn wa-al-waṣiyyu man waṣṣā al-nāsa bi-mā atāhu fī lawḥin ḥafīẓ.
:::

::: {.translation}
The Prophet is the one who has informed the people of this most upright, most ancient, eternal Announcement. The Messenger is the one who has conveyed My messages and guided those who have lost the way. The Imam is the one who has stood before My face in manifest humility. The guardian is the one who has taken refuge in the firm and mighty stronghold of My guardianship. The appointed successor is the one who has enjoined upon the people what has come to him in a preserved Tablet.
:::

### 215

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ان الذی اتخذه المشرکون ربا لانفسهم و اعرضوا به علی اللّه المقتدر العزیز الجمیل انه کان کاحد من العباد و کان ان یحضر تلقاء الوجه فی کل بکور و اصیل هبت علیه من شطر نفسه اریاح الهوی بما اغواه احد من الشیاطین انا شهرنا اسمه بین العباد حکمة من لدنا ان ربک هو الحاکم علی ما یرید " انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Inna alladhī ittakhadhahu al-mushrikūna rabban li-anfusihim wa-aʿraḍū bihi ʿalā Allāhi al-Muqtadiri al-ʿAzīzi al-Jamīl innahu kāna ka-aḥadin mina al-ʿibādi wa-kāna an yaḥḍura tilqāʾa al-wajhi fī kulli bukūrin wa-aṣīl habbat ʿalayhi min shaṭri nafsihi aryāḥu al-hawā bi-mā aghwāhu aḥadun mina al-shayāṭīn anā shahharnā ismahu bayna al-ʿibādi ḥikmatan min ladunnā inna rabbaka huwa al-ḥākimu ʿalā mā yurīd intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
The one whom those who associate partners with God have taken as a lord for themselves, and on whose account they have turned against God, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Beautiful, was but one of the servants, and used to appear before the Face every morning and evening. The winds of desire blew upon him from his own self, because one of the devils led him astray. We made his name renowned among the servants through a wisdom of Our own. Your Lord is indeed the One who decrees whatever He wills.” End of quotation.
:::

### 216

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ای دوستان صاحب بصر و فؤاد را یک ذکر از روی حقیقت کفایت مینماید در این حین بحضور فائز لسان عظمت باین کلمه ناطق قوله عز بیانه یا عبد حاضر بگو ای بی انصافها آیا امواج بحر بیان را مشاهده ننموده‌اید و یا اشراقات انوار آفتاب ظهور را ندیده‌اید اتقوا اللّه از غدیر ببحر و از وهم بیقین توجه نمائید امروز جمیع کتب او بلا و نعم معلق و منوط هذا بدیع السموات و الارض لو انتم تعرفون بدیع من کل جهات این ظهور بوده و هست طوبی للعارفین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ay dūstān ṣāḥeb-e baṣar va fuʾād rā yek dhekr az rū-ye ḥaqīqat kefāyat mīnamāyad dar īn ḥīn be-ḥuḍūr fāʾez lesān-e ʿaẓamat be-īn kalame nāṭeq qawluhu ʿazza bayānuhu yā ʿabd-e ḥāḍer begū ay bī-enṣāfhā āyā amvāj-e baḥr-e bayān rā moshāhede nanamūde-īd va yā eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e ẓuhūr rā nadīde-īd ittaqū Allāh az ghadīr be-baḥr va az vahm be-yaqīn tavajjoh namāyīd emrūz jamīʿ-e kotob-e ū be-lā va naʿam moʿallaq va manūṭ hādhā badīʿu al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍi law antum taʿrifūn badīʿ men koll-e jehāt īn ẓuhūr būde va hast ṭūbā li-al-ʿārifīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Friends, a single truthful reminder suffices for one possessed of sight and understanding. At this moment I attained His presence, and the Tongue of Grandeur spoke these words—exalted be His utterance: “Servant who is present, say: You who are unfair! Have you not beheld the waves of the ocean of utterance, or have you not seen the radiance of the lights of the sun of Revelation? Fear God. Turn from the pool to the ocean, and from illusion to certainty. Today all His Books depend upon and are subject to ‘No’ and ‘Yes.’ This is the Originator of the heavens and the earth, if you understand. This Revelation has been and remains wondrous in every respect. Blessed are those who recognize it.”
:::

### 217

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قل لیت افکاری افکارکم و لا امشی فی طرقکم قد اوضحت سبیلی و اظهرت دلیلی و انزلت آیاتی و دعوت العباد الی افقی منهم من اقبل و منهم من اعرض ان الذی اقبل انه من الفائزین فی کتاب مبین " انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul layta afkārī afkārukum wa-lā amshī fī ṭuruqikum qad awḍaḥtu sabīlī wa-aẓhartu dalīlī wa-anzaltu āyātī wa-daʿawtu al-ʿibāda ilā ufuqī minhum man aqbala wa-minhum man aʿraḍa inna alladhī aqbala innahu mina al-fāʾizīna fī kitābin mubīn intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
“Say: Would that My thoughts were your thoughts! I do not walk in your ways. I have made My path clear, manifested My proof, sent down My verses, and summoned the servants to My horizon. Some have turned toward Me, and others have turned away. Whoever has turned toward Me is indeed numbered among those who have attained success in a clear Book.” End of quotation.
:::

### 218

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ایکاش معرضین یک ورق از کتاب ایقان را ببصر عدل نظر مینمودند و بانصاف حکم میکردند معادله نمینماید بآن آنچه باین شأن از قبل نازل شده امروز کل در صقع واحد مشاهده میشوند هر نفسی بحبل متین تمسک نمود و بذیل منیر تشبث جست او از اهل بها در صحیفه حمراء از قلم اعلی مسطور امروز جمیع ذرات بر عظمت امر شاهد و گواهند و معرضین غافل و گمراه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ay kāsh moʿreḍīn yek varaq az Ketāb-e Īqān rā be-baṣar-e ʿadl naẓar mīnamūdand va be-enṣāf ḥokm mīkardand moʿādele nemīnamāyad be-ān ānche be-īn shaʾn az qabl nāzel shode emrūz koll dar ṣoqʿ-e vāḥed moshāhede mīshavand har nafsī be-ḥabl-e matīn tamassok namūd va be-dhayl-e monīr tashabboth jost ū az ahl-e Bahā dar ṣaḥīfe-ye ḥamrā az Qalam-e Aʿlā masṭūr emrūz jamīʿ-e dharrāt bar ʿaẓamat-e amr shāhed va govāhand va moʿreḍīn ghāfel va gomrāh.
:::

::: {.translation}
Would that those who turn away would look with the eye of justice at a single page of the Book of Certitude and judge fairly. Nothing previously revealed in this manner equals it. Today all are seen on a single plane. Whoever has held fast to the firm cord and clung to the luminous hem is inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Scroll as one of the people of Bahā. Today every atom bears witness and testifies to the greatness of the Cause, while those who turn away remain heedless and astray.
:::

### 219

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حضرت اعلی روح ما سواه فداه بر اثبات حقیتشان در آخر تفسیرها بشهادت دو عالم استدلال فرموده‌اند ملا عبد الخالق و حاج ملا محمد علی برقانی قزوینی میفرمایند قوله جل و عزّ و کفی بشادتهما فی حقی علی ذلک الامر شهیدا انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥażrat-e Aʿlā, rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu, bar ethbāt-e ḥaqqīyatashān dar ākhar-e tafsīrhā be-shahādat-e do ʿālem estedlāl farmūde-and: Mollā ʿAbd al-Khāleq va Ḥājj Mollā Moḥammad ʿAlī Barqānī Qazvīnī. Mīfarmāyand, qawluhu jalla wa ʿazza: «Wa kafā \[corrupted text\] fī ḥaqqī ʿalā dhālika al-amri shahīdan.» Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
The Most Exalted One—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—appealed, at the end of His commentaries, to the testimony of two scholars as proof of His truth: Mullā ʿAbd al-Khāliq and Ḥājj Mullā Muḥammad ʿAlī Barqānī Qazvīnī. He says—exalted and mighty are His words: “And \[corrupted original text\] suffices as a witness concerning Me in this matter.” End of quotation.
:::

### 220

::: {.original lang="fa"}
مع آنکه بعد از ملاحظه لوح مبارک که میفرماید اننی انا القائم الذی انتم بظهوره توعدون نفس اول اعراض نمود اعراض شدید و نفس ثانی هم من بعد اقبال ننمود و با احدی تقرب نجست چه که این دو عریضه در اول امر عرض نمودند حال ملاحظه نمائید چه مقدار از علما و عرفا و فقها نزد اشراق انوار آفتاب اینظهور اعظم خاضع و خاشع مشاهده گشتند اگر اسامی ذکر شود بر حسب ظاهر بیم ضرّ است از برای ایشان
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Maʿ ānke baʿd az molāḥeẓe-ye Lawḥ-e mobārak ke mīfarmāyad «Innanī anā al-Qāʾimu alladhī antum bi-ẓuhūrihi tūʿadūn», nafs-e avval eʿrāż namūd, eʿrāż-e shadīd, va nafs-e thānī ham men baʿd eqbāl nanamūd va bā aḥadī taqarrub najost, che ke īn do ʿarīże dar avval-e amr ʿarż namūdand. Ḥāl molāḥeẓe namāyīd che meqdār az ʿolamā va ʿorafā va foqahā nazd-e eshrāq-e anvār-e āftāb-e īn Ẓohūr-e Aʿẓam khāżeʿ va khāsheʿ moshāhede gashtand. Agar asāmī dhekr shavad, bar ḥasab-e ẓāher bīm-e żorr ast az barā-ye īshān.
:::

::: {.translation}
Yet, after reading the blessed Tablet in which He says, “I am indeed the Qāʾim whose appearance you have been promised,” the first person turned away, and did so vehemently; the second likewise did not turn toward Him thereafter, nor did he seek proximity to anyone, for these two had submitted their petitions at the beginning of the Cause. Now consider how many scholars, mystics, and jurists have been seen humble and submissive before the radiance of the Sun of this Most Great Revelation. If their names were mentioned, there would, outwardly, be reason to fear harm to them.
:::

### 221

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هر منصفی گواهی میدهد عالم دانائی ازاعمال معرضین و اقوال منکرین متحیر گاهی ذکر مرآت مینمایند و هنگامی ذکر وصی این ایام از کرمان الوهیت از برای مرجع خود ترتیب داده‌اند و نفس دیگر از اهل کاظمین ساکن کرمانشاه مثل رومی و چینی گفته تاللّه انهم و ما عندهم کبیوت العنکبوت بل اوهن لوهم ینصفون
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Har monṣefī gavāhī mīdahad. ʿĀlem-e dānāʾī az aʿmāl-e moʿreżīn va aqvāl-e monkerīn motaḥayyer. Gāhī dhekr-e Merʾāt mīnamāyand va hengāmī dhekr-e vaṣī. Īn ayyām az Kermān olūhīyat az barā-ye marjaʿ-e khod tartīb dāde-and va nafs-e dīgar az ahl-e Kāẓemayn, sāken-e Kermānshāh, mathal-e Rūmī va Chīnī gofte. Ta-llāhi innahum wa mā ʿindahum ka-buyūti al-ʿankabūt, bal awhanu law hum yunṣifūn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Every fair-minded person bears witness. A learned and knowledgeable person is bewildered by the actions of those who turn away and the words of the deniers. At times they speak of the Mirror, and at others of the appointed successor. These days, people in Kirmān have contrived divinity for their own leader, while another person, from Kāẓimayn and residing in Kirmānshāh, has recounted the parable of the Byzantine and the Chinese. By God, they and all they possess are like spiders’ webs—indeed, frailer still, if only they would judge fairly.
:::

### 222

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بگوئید ای بیچاره‌ها شما کجا بوده‌اید آیا غیر نفس حق کسی ظاهر بوده آیا از دون او قدرتی مشاهده شده عجب است از نفوسی که از امر اول آگاهی نداشته‌اند و فتوی میدهند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Begūʾīd: Ey bīchāre-hā, shomā kojā būde-īd? Āyā gheyr-e nafs-e Ḥaqq kasī ẓāher būde? Āyā az dūn-e Ū qodratī moshāhede shode? ʿAjab ast az nofūsī ke az amr-e avval āgāhī nadāshte-and va fatvā mīdahand.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: You hapless people, where have you been? Has anyone other than the True One Himself been manifest? Has any power been witnessed from anyone besides Him? How astonishing that people who have had no knowledge of the beginning of the Cause should issue rulings!
:::

### 223

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا محمد لعمر اللّه غافلی خبر نداری این عبد شمارا ندیده و لکن لوجه اللّه میگوید اتق اللّه بحق راجع شو تا باب مفتوح خود را محروم منما آن نفوسی که تو را القا نموده‌اند خود آگاه نبوده‌اند و از بحر دانش نصیب برنداشته‌اند نفسی که من غیر اللّه او را رب اخذ نموده آثارش نزدت موجود دیده و خوانده حال یک صفحه آیات حق را قرائت نما و خود انصاف ده
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Moḥammad, la-ʿamru Allāh, ghāfelī, khabar nadārī. Īn ʿabd shomā rā nadīde va lāken li-wajhi Allāh mīgūyad: Ittaqi Allāh. Be-Ḥaqq rājeʿ show. Tā bāb maftūḥ, khod rā maḥrūm manamā. Ān nofūsī ke to rā elqā namūde-and khod āgāh nabūde-and va az baḥr-e dānesh naṣīb barnadāshte-and. Nafsī ke min ghayri Allāh ū rā rabb akhdh namūde, āthārash nazdat mowjūd, dīde va khānde. Ḥāl yek ṣafḥe āyāt-e Ḥaqq rā qerāʾat namā va khod enṣāf deh.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Muḥammad, by the life of God, you are heedless and unaware. This servant has not seen you, but for the sake of God he says: Fear God. Return to the True One. While the door is open, do not deprive yourself. Those who have prompted you were themselves unaware and had gained no share of the ocean of knowledge. The writings of the person you have taken as a lord besides God are in your possession; you have seen and read them. Now read one page of the verses of the True One and judge fairly for yourself.
:::

### 224

::: {.original lang="fa"}
نقطه اولی روح ما سواه فداه میفرماید قوله جل و عزّ اگر کل اهل بیان در جوهر علم مثل او گردند که ثمر نمی بخشد الا بتصدیق او فلتعتبرن ان یا اولی العلم ثم ایاه تتقون انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Noqṭe-ye Ūlā, rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu, mīfarmāyad, qawluhu jalla wa ʿazza: «Agar koll-e ahl-e Bayān dar jowhar-e ʿelm methl-e ū gardand ke thamar namībakhshad ellā be-taṣdīq-e Ū. Fa-ltaʿtabirunna in yā ulī al-ʿilm, thumma iyyāhu tattaqūn.» Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
The Primal Point—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—says, exalted and mighty are His words: “Even if all the people of the Bayān should become like him in the essence of knowledge, it bears no fruit except through acknowledgment of Him. Take heed, then, O possessors of knowledge, and fear Him.” End of quotation.
:::

### 225

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ای برادر من اگر نفسی این امر را انکار نماید و از این ظهور اعظم غافل شود قادر بر اثبات هیچ امری نبوده و نیست این فانی را حزن از کل جهات بشأنی احاطه نموده که از اظهارش عاجز است چه که از برای شمس حقیقت بعد از ظهور و اشراق دلیل ذکر مینماید و این خطائی است کبیر باعلی النداء میفرماید انّی اکون مقدسا عن کل ما ذکر و سطر ان دلیلی ما ظهر من عندی و حجتی نفسی لو انتم من العارفین انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ey barādar-e man, agar nafsī īn Amr rā enkār namāyad va az īn Ẓohūr-e Aʿẓam ghāfel shavad, qāder bar ethbāt-e hīch amrī nabūde va nīst. Īn fānī rā ḥozn az koll-e jehāt be-shaʾnī eḥāṭe namūde ke az eẓhārash ʿājez ast, che ke az barā-ye Shams-e Ḥaqīqat baʿd az ẓohūr va eshrāq dalīl dhekr mīnamāyad va īn khaṭāʾī ast kabīr. Be-aʿlā al-nedā mīfarmāyad: «Innī akūnu muqaddasan ʿan kulli mā dhukira wa suṭira. Inna dalīlī mā ẓahara min ʿindī wa ḥujjatī nafsī, law antum mina al-ʿārifīn.» Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O my brother, anyone who denies this Cause and remains heedless of this Most Great Revelation has never been, and is not now, capable of proving any cause. Sorrow has surrounded this mortal one on every side to such a degree that he is powerless to express it, for he is adducing evidence for the Sun of Truth after its appearance and radiance, and this is a grave error. He proclaims in the loudest voice: “I am sanctified above all that has been mentioned and written. My proof is what has appeared from Me, and My testimony is My own Self, if you are among those who understand.” End of quotation.
:::

### 226

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ولکن این عبد چون بعضی را ضعیف مشاهده نموده بحبل استدلال تمسک جسته که شاید از معین کلمات الهی کوثر باقی بیاشامند و بزندگی دائمی فائز گردند و الا ان الدلیل یستحیی ان ینسب الیه و البرهان یخجل ان یسجد بین یدیه نعم ما قیل :
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va lāken īn ʿabd chon baʿżī rā żaʿīf moshāhede namūde, be-ḥabl-e estedlāl tamassok joste ke shāyad az maʿīn-e kalemāt-e elāhī Kowthar-e bāqī biyāshāmand va be-zendegī-ye dāʾemī fāʾez gardand. Va ellā inna al-dalīla yastaḥyī an yunsaba ilayhi wa al-burhāna yakhjalu an yasjuda bayna yadayhi. Neʿma mā qīl:
:::

::: {.translation}
But since this servant has seen that some are weak, he has clung to the cord of reasoning, so that perhaps they may drink the everlasting Kawthar from the wellspring of divine words and attain eternal life. Otherwise, evidence itself is ashamed to be attributed to Him, and proof blushes to bow down before Him. How well it has been said:
:::

### 227

::: {.original lang="ar"}
حق عیان چون مهر رخشان آمده حیف کاندر شهر کوران آمده
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥaqq ʿayān chon mehr-e rakhshān āmade, ḥeyf k-andar shahr-e kūrān āmade.
:::

::: {.translation}
The True One has appeared, plain as the radiant sun; alas that He has come into a city of the blind.
:::

### 228

::: {.original lang="fa"}
سزاوار انسان آنکه بطراز عدل و انصاف مزین باشد مالک وجودی که بنفسه امام عالم قیام فرموده و باسم قیومش رحیق مختوم را گشوده و معادل ما نزل من قبل و من بعد از قلم مبارکش جاری و نازل چگونه میتواند انسان در این مقام توقف نماید و یا نعوذ باللّه کلمهٴ نا لایق ادا کند بیان را نقطه اولی بید قدرت بیفشرد زلال آن این کلمه مبارکه است انه لا یستشار باشارتی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Sazāvār-e ensān ānke be-ṭerāz-e ʿadl va enṣāf mozayyan bāshad. Mālek-e vojūdī ke be-nafsehī amām-e ʿālam qīyām farmūde va be-esm-e Qayyūmash raḥīq-e makhtūm rā goshūde va moʿādel-e mā nazala min qabl va min baʿd az qalam-e mobārakash jārī va nāzel, chegūne mītavānad ensān dar īn maqām tavaqqof namāyad va yā naʿūdhu bi-llāh kalame-ye nā-lāyeq adā konad? Bayān rā Noqṭe-ye Ūlā be-yad-e qodrat bīfeshord; zolāl-e ān īn kalame-ye mobārake ast: «Innahu lā yustashāru bi-ishāratī.»
:::

::: {.translation}
It befits a human being to be adorned with justice and fairness. The Lord of existence has Himself arisen before the world, has unsealed the choice wine through His name, the Self-Subsisting, and from His blessed Pen has flowed and descended the equivalent of all that has been sent down before and after. How can anyone hesitate in this station, or, God forbid, utter an unworthy word? The Primal Point pressed the Bayān in the hand of power; its pure essence is this blessed utterance: “He is not to be consulted on the basis of My indication.”
:::

### 229

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یومی از ایام مقصود عالمیان باین کلمه علیا ناطق قوله جل جلاله یا عبد حاضر امروز اگر نفس نقطه در این امر توقف نماید از کلمهٴ رضا محروم ماند ناس در نوم غفلت و بصر اللّه از افق اعلی ناظر و شاهد انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yowmī az ayyām Maqṣūd-e ʿālamīyān be-īn kalame-ye ʿolyā nāṭeq, qawluhu jalla jalāluhu: «Yā ʿabd-e ḥāżer, emrūz agar nafs-e Noqṭe dar īn Amr tavaqqof namāyad, az kalame-ye reżā maḥrūm mānad. Nās dar nowm-e ghaflat va baṣar-e Allāh az ofoq-e aʿlā nāẓer va shāhed.» Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
One day the Desire of the worlds spoke these exalted words—glorified be His glory: “O servant who is present, today, if the Point Himself should hesitate in this Cause, He would be deprived of the word of approval. The people are in the sleep of heedlessness, while the eye of God watches and witnesses from the Most Exalted Horizon.” End of quotation.
:::

### 230

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هر صاحب شمی عرف بیان رحمن را ادراک مینماید حق بمثل وجودش ظاهر و هویدا حجباترا خرق فرمود سبحات را شق نمود مجدد سبب نشوید و ناس بیچاره را بمثل قبل در تیه اوهام مبتلا منمائید اتقوا اللّه یا معشر البیان و لا تکونوا من الظالمین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Har ṣāḥeb-e shammī ʿarf-e bayān-e Raḥmān rā edrāk mīnamāyad. Ḥaqq be-methl-e vojūdash ẓāher va hoveydā. Ḥojobāt rā kharq farmūd, soboḥāt rā shaqq namūd. Mojaddad sabab nashavīd va nās-e bīchāre rā be-methl-e qabl dar tīh-e owhām mobtalā manamāyīd. Ittaqū Allāha yā maʿshara al-Bayān wa lā takūnū mina al-ẓālimīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Anyone with a sense of smell perceives the fragrance of the All-Merciful’s utterance. The True One is as manifest and evident as His own existence. He has torn through the veils and rent the coverings of glory. Do not become a cause of these again, and do not, as before, leave the hapless people afflicted in the wilderness of vain imaginings. Fear God, O people of the Bayān, and do not be among the unjust.
:::

### 231

::: {.original lang="fa"}
نقطه اولی روح ما سواه فداه از اول ظهور الی آخر بذکر این اسم مبارک مشغول بهیچوجه در تشویق اهل بیان توقف نفرمودند هر لفظ مبارکی و هر کلمه مقدسهٴ طیبهٴ که در بیان نازل شده بحق جل جلاله نسبت داده‌اند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Noqṭe-ye Ūlā, rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu, az avval-e ẓohūr elā ākhar be-dhekr-e īn Esm-e mobārak mashghūl. Be-hīch-vajh dar tashvīq-e ahl-e Bayān tavaqqof nafarmūdand. Har lafẓ-e mobārakī va har kalame-ye moqaddase-ye ṭayyebe-ī ke dar Bayān nāzel shode be-Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, nesbat dāde-and.
:::

::: {.translation}
The Primal Point—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—was occupied, from the beginning of His revelation to its end, with the mention of this blessed Name. He never ceased to encourage the people of the Bayān. Every blessed expression and every holy and goodly word revealed in the Bayān He ascribed to the True One, glorified be His glory.
:::

### 232

::: {.original lang="fa"}
سبحان اللّه جهالت و نادانی بمقامی است و غل و بغضاء بشأنی است که اذان را از اصغاء منع نموده قسم بآفتاب افق معانی اگر بعضی از آیات منزله در ذکر این ظهور اعظم بر حجر القاء شود لینفجر منه الانهار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Subḥāna Allāh, jahālat va nādānī be-maqāmī ast va ghell va baghżā be-shaʾnī ast ke ādhān rā az eṣghā manʿ namūde. Qasam be-āftāb-e ofoq-e maʿānī, agar baʿżī az āyāt-e monzale dar dhekr-e īn Ẓohūr-e Aʿẓam bar ḥajar elqā shavad, la-yanfajiru minhu al-anhār.
:::

::: {.translation}
Glory be to God! Ignorance and folly have reached such a degree, and malice and hatred such an intensity, that they have prevented ears from listening. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of meanings: if some of the verses revealed concerning this Most Great Revelation were cast upon a stone, rivers would surely gush from it.
:::

### 233

::: {.original lang="fa"}
وقتی از اوقات این کلمه علیا از لسان مولی الوری استماع شد یا عبد حاضر بیاناتی که از ملکوت علم الهی در این ظهور ظاهر شده گوش بخشد و القا نماید محزون مباش از گفته‌های این و آن یک نفس اگر حلاوت بیان رحمن را بیابد او عند اللّه از من علی الارض اقدم و افضل و اظهر و اعلم و اعلی بوده انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Vaqtī az owqāt īn kalame-ye ʿolyā az lesān-e Mawlā al-Warā estemāʿ shod: «Yā ʿabd-e ḥāżer, bayānātī ke az malakūt-e ʿelm-e elāhī dar īn Ẓohūr ẓāher shode gūsh bakhshad va elqā namāyad. Maḥzūn mabāsh az gofte-hā-ye īn va ān. Yek nafs agar ḥalāvat-e bayān-e Raḥmān rā biyābad, ū ʿinda Allāh az man ʿalā al-arḍ aqdam va afżal va aẓhar va aʿlam va aʿlā būde.» Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
On one occasion these exalted words were heard from the tongue of the Lord of all people: “O servant who is present, the utterances that have appeared in this Revelation from the kingdom of divine knowledge bestow ears and impart their message. Do not be saddened by what this person or that person says. If a single soul discovers the sweetness of the All-Merciful’s utterance, that soul is, in God’s sight, above all who are on earth in precedence, excellence, manifestness, knowledge, and loftiness.” End of quotation.
:::

### 234

::: {.original lang="fa"}
نقطه اولی روح ما سواه فداه میفرماید اگردر یوم ظهور او یک نفس مؤمن باشد بعث کل نبیین در نفس او میشود این عبد گاهی که در قدرت و عظمت و سلطنت حق جل جلاله نظر مینماید ابواب رجا مفتوح میشود لذا استدعا مینماید که جمیع من علی الارض را از نفحات ایّامش محروم نفرماید و چون در غفلت اهل بیان و ضغینه و بغضای آن نفوس ملاحظه میشود یأس کلی حاصل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Noqṭe-ye Ūlā, rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu, mīfarmāyad: «Agar dar yowm-e ẓohūr-e Ū yek nafs moʾmen bāshad, baʿth-e koll-e nabīyīn dar nafs-e ū mīshavad.» Īn ʿabd gāhī ke dar qodrat va ʿaẓamat va salṭanat-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, naẓar mīnamāyad, abvāb-e rajā maftūḥ mīshavad. Ledhā estedʿā mīnamāyad ke jamīʿ-e man ʿalā al-arḍ rā az nafaḥāt-e ayyāmash maḥrūm nafarmāyad. Va chon dar ghaflat-e ahl-e Bayān va żaghīne va baghżā-ye ān nofūs molāḥeẓe mīshavad, yaʾs-e kollī ḥāṣel.
:::

::: {.translation}
The Primal Point—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—says: “If on the day of His appearance there is a single believing soul, the resurrection of all the Prophets takes place in that soul.” Whenever this servant considers the power, grandeur, and sovereignty of the True One, glorified be His glory, the doors of hope open. He therefore entreats Him not to deprive anyone on earth of the breezes of His days. But when the heedlessness of the people of the Bayān and the rancor and hatred of those souls are considered, utter despair ensues.
:::

### 235

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اگر چه این عبد بگمان خود از این تحریرات انتباه و آگاهی نفوس را خواسته ولکن مشاهده میشود نقطه اولی روح ما سواه فداه بشأنی در این ظهور اعظم ذکر فرموده‌اند که ما فوق آن متصوّر نه مع ذلک میفرمایند بقدر اسم مؤمن هم در حق او راضی نمیشوند چه که اگر راضی شوند حزن بر او وارد نمیآوردند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Agar che īn ʿabd be-gomān-e khod az īn taḥrīrāt entebāh va āgāhī-ye nofūs rā khāste, va lāken moshāhede mīshavad Noqṭe-ye Ūlā, rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu, be-shaʾnī dar īn Ẓohūr-e Aʿẓam dhekr farmūde-and ke mā fowq-e ān motaṣavvar na. Maʿa dhālek mīfarmāyand: «Be-qadr-e esm-e moʾmen ham dar ḥaqq-e Ū rāżī namīshavand, che ke agar rāżī shavand ḥozn bar Ū vāred namīāvardand.»
:::

::: {.translation}
Although this servant, as he sees it, has sought through these writings to awaken souls and make them aware, it is evident that the Primal Point—may the spirit of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—has spoken of this Most Great Revelation in such a manner that nothing beyond it can be conceived. Nevertheless, He says: “They will not be willing to accord Him even the name of believer, for if they were willing, they would not bring sorrow upon Him.”
:::

### 236

::: {.original lang="fa"}
فی الحقیقه این بیان نقطهٴ بیان روح من فی الامکان فداه کتاب وعظ است و دفتر نصح و صحیفهٴ انتباه ولکن لا یزید الظالمین الا خسارا و لا یزید الغافلین الا انکارا و لا یزید الفاسقین الّا فرارا
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Fī al-ḥaqīqe īn bayān-e Noqṭe-ye Bayān, rūḥu man fī al-imkān fidāhu, ketāb-e vaʿẓ ast va daftar-e noṣḥ va ṣaḥīfe-ye entebāh, va lāken lā yazīdu al-ẓālimīna illā khasāran wa lā yazīdu al-ghāfilīna illā inkāran wa lā yazīdu al-fāsiqīna illā firāran.
:::

::: {.translation}
In truth, this utterance of the Point of the Bayān—may the spirit of all in the contingent world be sacrificed for Him—is a book of admonition, a volume of counsel, and a scroll of awakening. Yet it only increases the loss of the unjust, the denial of the heedless, and the flight of the transgressors.
:::

### 237

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این فانی امام وجوه کل عرض مینماید در حالتیکه قلبش فارغ است از ظنون و اوهام و ضغینه وبغضای نفسی از نفوس آیا اگر نقطه بیان یعنی منزل آن بفرماید یا معشر البیان بچه حجت و برهان از این ظهور اعظم محتجب مانده‌اید بچه جواب متمسک و متشبث میشوید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn fānī amām-e vojūh-e koll ʿarż mīnamāyad, dar ḥālatī ke qalbash fāregh ast az ẓonūn va owhām va żaghīne va baghżā-ye nafsī az nofūs: Āyā agar Noqṭe-ye Bayān, yaʿnī Monzel-e ān, befarmāyad «Yā maʿshara al-Bayān, be-che ḥojjat va borhān az īn Ẓohūr-e Aʿẓam moḥtajeb mānde-īd?», be-che javāb motamassek va motashabbeth mīshavīd?
:::

::: {.translation}
This mortal one submits before everyone, his heart free of suspicions and vain imaginings and of rancor and hatred toward any soul: If the Point of the Bayān, that is, its Revealer, were to say, “O people of the Bayān, on what evidence and proof have you remained veiled from this Most Great Revelation?”, what answer would you seize upon and cling to?
:::

### 238

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اگر میگوئید بمن محتجب شده‌اید جمیع ذرات کائنات شاهد و گواه که من اخذ عهد او را قبل از اخذ عهد خود نموده‌ام سبحانک اللّهم فاشهد بانی بذلک الکتاب قد اخذت عهد ولایة من تظهرنه عن کل شئ قبل عهد ولایتی و کفی بک و بمن آمن بآیاتک علی شهداء و انّک انت حسبی علیک توکلت و انت کنت علی کل شئ حسیبا
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Agar mīgūʾīd be-man moḥtajeb shode-īd, jamīʿ-e dharrāt-e kāʾenāt shāhed va gavāh ke man akhdh-e ʿahd-e Ū rā qabl az akhdh-e ʿahd-e khod namūde-am. Subḥānaka Allāhumma fa-shhad bi-annī bi-dhālika al-kitābi qad akhadhtu ʿahda wilāyati man tuẓhirannahu ʿan kulli shayʾin qabla ʿahdi wilāyatī, wa kafā bika wa bi-man āmana bi-āyātika ʿalayya shuhadāʾa, wa innaka anta ḥasbī, ʿalayka tawakkaltu wa anta kunta ʿalā kulli shayʾin ḥasīban.
:::

::: {.translation}
If you say that you have become veiled because of Me, every atom of creation bears witness and testifies that I took the covenant of allegiance to Him before taking the covenant of allegiance to Myself. “Glory be to You, O God! Bear witness that through that Book I have taken from all things the covenant of allegiance to Him whom You will make manifest before the covenant of allegiance to Myself. You and those who have believed in Your verses suffice as witnesses concerning Me. You are indeed sufficient for Me. In You have I placed My trust, and You have ever taken account of all things.”
:::

### 239

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و به بیانی که اظهر از شمس است در وسط سماء کل را وصیت نموده‌ام که بمن از آن مقصود عالمیان محجوب نمانید نفس کتاب شاهد و گواه و اگر به بیان از آن سلطان ایام محروم مانده‌اید هر سطری و هر ورقی از آن شاهد وگواه که من باعلی النداء گفته‌ام بجمیع بیان و منزل و مظهر وسلطان آن محروم نمانید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va be-bayānī ke aẓhar az shams ast dar vasaṭ-e samā koll rā vaṣīyat namūde-am ke be-man az ān Maqṣūd-e ʿālamīyān maḥjūb namānīd. Nafs-e Ketāb shāhed va gavāh. Va agar be-Bayān az ān Solṭān-e ayyām maḥrūm mānde-īd, har saṭrī va har varaqī az ān shāhed va gavāh ke man be-aʿlā al-nedā gofte-am: Be-jamīʿ-e Bayān va Monzel va Maẓhar va Solṭān-e ān maḥrūm namānīd.
:::

::: {.translation}
And in words more evident than the sun in the midst of heaven, I counseled everyone not to remain veiled by Me from that Desire of the worlds. The Book itself bears witness and testifies. And if, because of the Bayān, you have remained deprived of that Sovereign of days, every line and every leaf of it bears witness and testifies that I proclaimed in the loudest voice: Do not let the whole Bayān, or its Revealer, its Manifestation, and its Sovereign, deprive you of Him.
:::

### 240

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اگر بوصفی ناظرید و از مالک اوصاف ممنوع گشته‌اید بتصریح تمام گفته‌ام که کل آنچه ذکر خیر در بیان نازل شده مقصود آن شمس ظهور بوده و اگر بلفظ مرآت از شمس معانی محتجب شده‌اید قد نزلت فی الکتاب ان یا شموس المرایا انتم الی شمس الحقیقه تنظرون فان قیامکم بها لو انتم تتبصرون کلکم کحیتان بالماء فی البحر تتحرکون و تحتجبون عن المأ و تسئلون عما انتم به قائمون الی آخر قولی لاشکون الیک ان یا مرآت جودی عن کل المرایا کل بالوانهم الی لینظرون
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Agar be-vaṣfī nāẓerīd va az Mālek-e owṣāf mamnūʿ gashteh-īd, be-taṣrīḥ-e tamām gofteh-am keh koll-e āncheh dhekr-e kheyr dar Bayān nāzel shodeh maqṣūd ān Shams-e Ẓohūr būdeh, va agar be-lafẓ-e merʾāt az Shams-e Maʿānī moḥtajeb shodeh-īd, qad nazalat fī al-Kitāb: an yā shumūs al-marāyā, antum ilā Shams al-Ḥaqīqa tanẓurūn, fa-inna qiyāmakum bihā law antum tatabaṣṣarūn. Kullukum ka-ḥītān bi-l-māʾ fī al-baḥr tataḥarrakūn wa taḥtajibūn ʿan al-māʾ wa tasʾalūn ʿammā antum bihi qāʾimūn. Ilā ākhir-i qawlī: la-ashkuwanna ilayka, an yā Mirʾāt Jūdī, ʿan kull al-marāyā; kullun bi-alwānihim ilayya la-yanẓurūn.
:::

::: {.translation}
If you are looking to an attribute and have been kept from the Possessor of all attributes, I have stated with complete explicitness that everything spoken of favorably in the Bayān was intended to refer to that Sun of Revelation. And if the word “mirror” has veiled you from the Sun of Meanings, this has been revealed in the Book: “O suns of the mirrors! You look toward the Sun of Truth, for your existence depends on it, if only you could perceive. You are all like fish moving through the water in the sea, yet you are veiled from the water and ask about that upon which your existence depends.” And so on, to My words: “I will surely complain to You, O Mirror of My bounty, of all the mirrors: each looks toward Me in its own colors.”
:::

### 241

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و اگر بذکر ثمره محتجب مانده‌اید هذا عهدی و میثاقی مع ربی من قبل و من بعد و اجعل اللّهم تلک الشجرة کلها له لیظهرن منها ثمرات ما خلق اللّه فیها لمن قد اراد اللّه ان یظهر به ما اراد فاننی انا و عزتک ما اردت ان یکون علی تلک الشجرة من غصن و لا ورق و لا ثمر لن یسجد له یوم ظهوره و لا یسبحک به بما ینبغی لعلو علو ظهوره و سموّ سموّ بطونه و ان شهدت یا الهی علیّ من غصن او ورق او ثمر لم یسجد له یوم ظهوره فاقطعه اللّهم عن تلک الشجرة فانه لم یکن منی و لا یرجع الیّ
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va agar be-dhekr-e thamareh moḥtajeb māndeh-īd, hādhā ʿahdī wa-mīthāqī maʿa Rabbī min qablu wa-min baʿdu. Wa-jʿal, Allāhumma, tilka al-shajarata kullahā lahu, li-yaẓharanna minhā thamarātu mā khalaqa Allāhu fīhā li-man qad arāda Allāhu an yuẓhira bihi mā arāda. Fa-innanī anā wa-ʿizzatika mā aradtu an yakūna ʿalā tilka al-shajarati min ghuṣnin wa-lā waraqin wa-lā thamarin lan yasjuda lahu yawma ẓuhūrihi wa-lā yusabbiḥaka bihi bi-mā yanbaghī li-ʿuluwwi ʿuluwwi ẓuhūrihi wa-sumūwwi sumūwwi buṭūnihi. Wa-in shahidta, yā Ilāhī, ʿalayya min ghuṣnin aw waraqin aw thamarin lam yasjud lahu yawma ẓuhūrihi, fa-qṭaʿhu, Allāhumma, ʿan tilka al-shajarati, fa-innahu lam yakun minnī wa-lā yarjiʿu ilayya.
:::

::: {.translation}
And if mention of the fruit has left you veiled: “This is My covenant and My pledge with My Lord, before and after. Make that Tree, O God, entirely His, so that from it may appear the fruits of what God has created within it for Him through whom God has willed to manifest whatever He has willed. By Your might, I have never desired that there should be upon that Tree any branch, leaf, or fruit that will not bow down before Him on the day of His appearance, or will not glorify You through Him as befits the loftiest heights of His manifestation and the most exalted sublimity of His concealment. And if You witness in Me, O my God, any branch, leaf, or fruit that does not bow down before Him on the day of His appearance, cut it off from that Tree, O God, for it is not of Me and does not return to Me.”
:::

### 242

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اگر بذکر مستغاث محتجب مانده‌اید این ندا از جمیع بیان مرتفع اگر در این حین ظاهر شود من اول عابدین و اول ساجدینم اگر بکلماتی متمسکید بتأکید تمام ذکر نموده‌ام که جمیع بیان معادله بیک آیه او نمیکند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Agar be-dhekr-e Mostaghāth moḥtajeb māndeh-īd, īn nedā az jamīʿ-e Bayān mortafeʿ: agar dar īn ḥīn ẓāher shavad, man avval-e ʿābedīn va avval-e sājedīnam. Agar be-kalamātī motamassekīd, be-taʾkīd-e tamām dhekr namūdeh-am keh jamīʿ-e Bayān moʿādeleh be-yek āyeh-ye Ū nemīkonad.
:::

::: {.translation}
If mention of the Mustaghāth has left you veiled, this call rises from the whole Bayān: “If He were to appear at this very moment, I would be the first to worship Him and the first to bow down before Him.” If you cling to certain words, I have stated with the utmost emphasis that the whole Bayān does not equal a single verse of His.
:::

### 243

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حال ای قوم آیا آن نفسی که من دون او اخذ نموده‌اید و کلمات او را آیات فرض گرفته‌اید از من و بیان من اعلی و احبّ است نزد شما افّ لکم و لقلة شعورکم و عدم وفائکم اعظم اوهامات و ظنون شما آنکه ظهورم را مثل ظهور قبل فرض نموده‌اید خلیفه و وصی تعیین مینمائید بالمره از یوم اللّه و شأن او محجوبید و از اشراقات انوار آفتاب توحید حقیقی محروم و بی خبر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥāl ey qowm, āyā ān nafsī keh min dūn-e Ū akhdh namūdeh-īd va kalamāt-e ū rā āyāt farż gerefteh-īd az man va Bayān-e man aʿlā va aḥabb ast nazd-e shomā? Uffin lakum wa-li-qillati shuʿūrikum wa-ʿadami wafāʾikum. Aʿẓam-e owhāmāt va ẓonūn-e shomā ānkeh ẓohūram rā methl-e ẓohūr-e qabl farż namūdeh-īd, khalīfeh va vaṣī taʿyīn mīnamāyīd. Be-l-marreh az Yowm-e Allāh va shaʾn-e Ū maḥjūbīd va az eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e towḥīd-e ḥaqīqī maḥrūm va bī-khabar.
:::

::: {.translation}
Now, people, is the one you have chosen instead of Him, whose words you have assumed to be divine verses, more exalted and dearer to you than I and My Bayān? Shame on you for your lack of understanding and your faithlessness! Your greatest delusion and vain imagining is that you have assumed My Revelation to be like the Revelation before it, and you appoint a successor and an executor. You are utterly veiled from the Day of God and its station, and are deprived and unaware of the radiance of the Sun of true unity.
:::

### 244

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ای ظالمان هنوز از قمیصم عرف دم اطهرم متضوع سیف‌های آن ملحدین که در هزار و دویست سنه بصیقل غل و بغضا مهیا نمودند و از سموم آبش دادند آیا کفایت ننموده که مجدد در تیه این اوهامات هائمید بآنچه در طول هزار و دویست سنه عامل شدید قناعت نمائید آیا در بیان نازل نشده باسماء از مالک آن محتجب نمانید حتی اسم النبی فان ذلک الاسم یخلق بقوله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ey ẓālemān, hanūz az qamīṣam ʿarf-e dam-e aṭharam motaḍavveʿ. Seyf-hā-ye ān molḥedīn keh dar hezār va devīst saneh be-ṣeyqal-e ghell va baghżā mohayyā namūdand va az somūm ābash dādand, āyā kefāyat nanamūdeh keh mojaddad dar tīh-e īn owhāmāt hāʾemīd? Be-āncheh dar ṭūl-e hezār va devīst saneh ʿāmel shodīd qanāʿat namāyīd. Āyā dar Bayān nāzel nashodeh: be-asmāʾ az Mālek-e ān moḥtajeb namānīd, ḥattā ism al-Nabī, fa-inna dhālika al-isma yukhlaqu bi-qawlihi?
:::

::: {.translation}
You oppressors! The fragrance of My most pure blood still wafts from My garment. Have the swords of those unbelievers, which they prepared over twelve hundred years with the polish of malice and hatred and tempered with poisons, not sufficed, that you wander once again in the wilderness of these delusions? Be content with what you have done over the course of twelve hundred years. Has it not been revealed in the Bayān: “Do not let names veil you from their Possessor, even the name ‘Prophet,’ for that name is created by His word”?
:::

### 245

::: {.original lang="fa"}
سبحان اللّه با امواج بحر بیان حضرت رحمن و اشراقات انوار آفتاب نصح و ظهورات نیر تدبیر و تعلیم از یمین قلب مبارک نقطه روح ما سواه فداه اریاح یاسیه در هبوب بشأنیکه حزن عالم را احاطه نموده و سبب یأس افئده مقدسه منوره شده مخصوص این فانی را بشأنی اخذ نموده که ظهور غیر آن را از محالات شمرده
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Subḥān Allāh! Bā amvāj-e baḥr-e bayān-e Ḥażrat-e Raḥmān va eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e noṣḥ va ẓohūrāt-e nayyer-e tadbīr va taʿlīm az yamīn-e qalb-e mobārak-e Noqṭeh, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, aryāḥ-e yaʾsīyeh dar hobūb, be-shaʾnī-keh ḥozn ʿālam rā eḥāṭeh namūdeh va sabab-e yaʾs-e afʾedeh-ye moqaddaseh-ye monavvareh shodeh. Makhṣūṣ īn fānī rā be-shaʾnī akhdh namūdeh keh ẓohūr-e gheyr-e ān rā az moḥālāt shomordeh.
:::

::: {.translation}
Glory be to God! Despite the waves of the ocean of the All-Merciful’s utterance, the radiance of the sun of counsel, and the dawning of the luminary of guidance and instruction from the right side of the blessed heart of the Point—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—the winds of despair are blowing so fiercely that sorrow has encompassed the world and brought despair to sanctified, illumined hearts. It has seized this transient one in particular so completely that he considers the appearance of anything else impossible.
:::

### 246

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در باب سابع از واحد ثانی میفرماید قوله جل و عزّ ای اهل بیان نکرده آنچه اهل قرآن کردند که ثمرات لیل خود را باطل کنید اگر آنچه که مؤمن به بیان هستید در حین ظهور آیات او گفتید اللّه ربنا و لا نشرک به احد او ان هذا ما وعدنا اللّه من مظهر نفسه لن ندعو معه شیئا و بر آنچه بر او هستید اطاعت او کردید ثمره بیان را ظاهر کرده‌اید و الا لایق ذکر نیستید نزد خداوند ترحم بر خود کرده اگر نصرت نمیکنید مظهر ربوبیت را محزون نکرده الی قوله جل شأنه اگر بلقاء اللّه فائز نمیگردید آیة اللّه را هم محزون نکرده باشید از نفع مدینین به بیان میگذرد هر گاه شما از ضرر باو بگذارید اگر چه میدانم نخواهید کرد انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar bāb-e sābeʿ az vāḥed-e thānī mīfarmāyad, qawluhu jalla wa-ʿazza: Ey ahl-e Bayān, nakardeh āncheh ahl-e Qorʾān kardand keh thamarāt-e leyl-e khod rā bāṭel konīd. Agar āncheh keh moʾmen be-Bayān hastīd, dar ḥīn-e ẓohūr-e āyāt-e Ū goftīd: Allāhu Rabbunā wa-lā nushriku bihi aḥad, aw inna hādhā mā waʿadanā Allāhu min maẓhari nafsihi, lan nadʿuwa maʿahu shayʾan, va bar āncheh bar ū hastīd eṭāʿat-e Ū kardīd, thamareh-ye Bayān rā ẓāher kardeh-īd, va ellā lāyeq-e dhekr nīstīd nazd-e Khodāvand. Taraḥḥom bar khod kardeh, agar noṣrat nemīkonīd, Maẓhar-e Robūbīyat rā maḥzūn nakardeh. Ilā qawlihi jalla shaʾnuhu: Agar be-leqāʾ Allāh fāʾez nemīgardīd, Āyat Allāh rā ham maḥzūn nakardeh bāshīd. Az nafʿ-e motadayyenīn be-Bayān mīgodharad har gāh shomā az żarar be-Ū bogdhārīd, agarcheh mīdānam nakhāhīd kard. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the seventh chapter of the second Vāḥid, He says—exalted and mighty are His words: “People of the Bayān! Do not do what the people of the Qurʾān did, thereby rendering the fruits of your own night futile. If, to the extent that you believe in the Bayān, you say at the appearance of His verses, ‘God is our Lord, and we associate no one with Him,’ or ‘This is what God promised us through the Manifestation of Himself; we will invoke nothing alongside Him,’ and if, in whatever state you are, you obey Him, you will have brought forth the fruit of the Bayān. Otherwise, you are unworthy of mention before God. Have mercy on yourselves: if you do not aid the Manifestation of Lordship, do not grieve Him.” And further, He says—exalted is His station: “If you do not attain the presence of God, at least do not grieve the Sign of God. He will forgo any benefit from the followers of the Bayān if you will refrain from harming Him, although I know you will not.” End of quotation.
:::

### 247

::: {.original lang="ar"}
سبحان اللّه مشاهده نمائید آن طلعت مبارک را چه مقدار یأس اخذ نموده که مع وصایای لا تحصی و عهدهای محکمه و میثاقهای متقنه و تدبیرهای معلنه یأس اکبر از بیانات مبارک ظاهر و مشهود طوبی للباکین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Subḥān Allāh! Moshāhedeh namāyīd ān Ṭalʿat-e Mobārak rā cheh meqdār yaʾs akhdh namūdeh keh maʿ-e vaṣāyā-ye lā toḥṣā va ʿahd-hā-ye moḥkameh va mīthāq-hā-ye motqaneh va tadbīr-hā-ye moʿlaneh, yaʾs-e akbar az bayānāt-e mobārak ẓāher va mashhūd. Ṭūbā li-l-bākīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Glory be to God! Consider how deeply despair had seized that blessed Countenance: despite His countless counsels, firm covenants, binding pledges, and openly declared measures, the greatest despair is evident and manifest in His blessed utterances. Blessed are those who weep.
:::

### 248

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و در مقام شفقت کبری و عالم آگاهی میفرمایند قوله عزّ و جل چه بسا نوری را که نار میفرماید باو و همچنین میفرماید قوله عزّ ذکره اگر چه می‌بینم ظهور او رامثل این شمس در وسط السماء و غروب کل را بمثل نجوم لیل در نهار هر صاحب سمع و بصری شهادت میدهد بر اینکه آنحضرت روح ما سواه فداه در جمیع احیان بذکر محبوب امکان مشغول بوده‌اند و بجمیع تدبیرات قلمیه و بیانیه و ذکریه اخبار فرموده‌اند بآنچه از اهل بیان ظاهر شده و میشود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va dar maqām-e shafaqat-e kobrā va ʿālam-e āgāhī mīfarmāyand, qawluhu ʿazza wa-jalla: Cheh basā nūrī rā keh nār mīfarmāyad be-ū. Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad, qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu: Agarcheh mībīnam ẓohūr-e Ū rā methl-e īn shams dar vasaṭ-e samāʾ va ghorūb-e koll rā be-methl-e nojūm-e leyl dar nahār. Har ṣāḥeb-e samʿ va baṣarī shahādat mīdahad bar īnkeh ān Ḥażrat, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, dar jamīʿ-e aḥyān be-dhekr-e Maḥbūb-e emkān mashghūl būdeh-and va be-jamīʿ-e tadbīrāt-e qalamīyeh va bayānīyeh va dhekrīyeh ekhbār farmūdeh-and be-āncheh az ahl-e Bayān ẓāher shodeh va mīshavad.
:::

::: {.translation}
And from the station of supreme compassion and the realm of awareness, He says—exalted and glorious are His words: “How often He calls a light ‘fire.’” He also says—exalted be His remembrance: “Although I see His appearance as this sun in the midst of heaven, and the setting of all others as the stars of night in the daytime.” Everyone with hearing and sight bears witness that He—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—was at all times occupied with mention of the Beloved of all existence, and that through every means of writing, exposition, and admonition He foretold what has proceeded and will proceed from the people of the Bayān.
:::

### 249

::: {.original lang="fa"}
لعمر مقصودی و مقصود من فی الارض و السماء ان اسفه عظیم و حزنه کبیر و یأسه عمن فی البیان اعظم من کل عظیم ای معشر غافلین بشنوید عرض این خادم فانی را و بهواهای نفسانیه و مفتریات نالایقه ذیل اطهر اقدس را میالائید اگر اقبال نمینمائید ساکت باشید میفرماید عزّ ذکره در بیان هیچ ذکری نیست مگر ذکر او لعل در وقت ظهور مشاهده حزن نفرماید از مؤمنین بخود و همچنین باین کلمه مبارکه که بمثابه نور است ما بین عالم نطق فرموده قوله جل و عزّ بیان از اول تا آخر مکمن جمیع صفات اوست و خزانه نار و نور او
:::

::: {.transliteration}
La-ʿamri Maqṣūdī wa-Maqṣūdi man fī al-arḍi wa-l-samāʾ, inna asafahu ʿaẓīmun wa-ḥuznahu kabīrun wa-yaʾsahu ʿamman fī al-Bayān aʿẓamu min kulli ʿaẓīm. Ey maʿshar-e ghāfelīn, beshnavīd ʿarż-e īn khādem-e fānī rā va be-havā-hā-ye nafsānīyeh va moftarayāt-e nālāyeqeh dheyl-e aṭhar-e aqdas rā mayālāyīd. Agar eqbāl nemīnamāyīd, sāket bāshīd. Mīfarmāyad, ʿazza dhikruhu: Dar Bayān hīch dhekrī nīst magar dhekr-e Ū, laʿall dar vaqt-e ẓohūr moshāhedeh-ye ḥozn nafarmāyad az moʾmenīn be-khod. Va hamchenīn be-īn kalameh-ye mobārakeh keh be-mathābeh-ye nūr ast mā beyn-e ʿālam noṭq farmūdeh, qawluhu jalla wa-ʿazza: Bayān az avval tā ākhar makman-e jamīʿ-e ṣefāt-e Ūst va khazāneh-ye nār va nūr-e Ū.
:::

::: {.translation}
By the life of my Desire and the Desire of all who are in earth and heaven! His anguish is immense, His sorrow great, and His despair of those in the Bayān greater than any greatness. You heedless ones! Listen to the plea of this transient servant, and do not stain that most pure and holy hem with selfish desires and unworthy fabrications. If you will not turn toward Him, remain silent. He says—exalted be His remembrance: “There is no mention in the Bayān except mention of Him, so that at the time of His appearance He may perhaps experience no sorrow from those who believe in Me.” He has also spoken these blessed words, which are like a light amid the world—exalted and mighty are His words: “The Bayān, from beginning to end, is the repository of all His attributes and the treasury of His fire and His light.”
:::

### 250

::: {.original lang="fa"}
امید هست که ناس غافل از آنچه ذکر شد بسماء آگاهی عروج نمایند چنانچه میفرماید قوله عز ذکره اگر کل بتربیت نقطه بیان مربی شوند و ناظر بمبدء و حجت و دلیل باشند در حین ظهور محتجب نمیمانند در این مقام میفرماید قوله تعالی گویا دیده میشود که کل این اصحاب بشرف ایمان بآن شمس حقیقت مستضئی گشته در تلویحات وتصریحات ملاحظه نمائید میفرمایند امید هست که این اصحاب یعنی اصحاب موجوده بشرف ایمان فائز شوند چنانچه شدند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Omīd hast keh nās-e ghāfel az āncheh dhekr shod be-samā-ye āgāhī ʿorūj namāyand. Chenāncheh mīfarmāyad, qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu: Agar koll be-tarbīyat-e Noqṭeh-ye Bayān morabbā shavand va nāẓer be-mabdaʾ va ḥojjat va dalīl bāshand, dar ḥīn-e ẓohūr moḥtajeb nemīmānand. Dar īn maqām mīfarmāyad, qawluhu taʿālā: Gūyā dīdeh mīshavad keh koll-e īn aṣḥāb be-sharaf-e īmān be-ān Shams-e Ḥaqīqat mostażīʾ gashteh. Dar talvīḥāt va taṣrīḥāt molāḥeẓeh namāyīd. Mīfarmāyand: Omīd hast keh īn aṣḥāb, yaʿnī aṣḥāb-e mowjūdeh, be-sharaf-e īmān fāʾez shavand, chenāncheh shodand.
:::

::: {.translation}
It is hoped that, through what has been mentioned, the heedless may ascend to the heaven of awareness. As He says—exalted be His remembrance: “If all are educated by the Point of the Bayān and look to the Source, the proof, and the evidence, they will not remain veiled at the time of the appearance.” In this connection He says—exalted are His words: “It is as though one sees all these companions illumined by the honor of faith in that Sun of Truth.” Consider the allusions and explicit statements. He says that it is hoped these companions, meaning the companions then living, will attain the honor of faith, as indeed they did.
:::

### 251

::: {.original lang="fa"}
خدای واحد شاهد و حق آگاه گواه که این فانی خالصانه لوجهه و لاولیائه و لاحبائه ذکر نمود آنچه که منصفین را نفع بخشد و نجات دهد از بیانات نقطه اولی روح ما سواه فداه چه عربی و چه فارسی آنچه در نظر بود بعضی از آن ذکر شد اگر چه الیوم ام البیان میفرماید جمیع بیان ذکری است از او و برد و قبول او معلق و منوط
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Khodā-ye Vāḥed shāhed va Ḥaqq-e Āgāh govāh keh īn fānī khāleṣāneh li-wajhihi wa-li-awliyāʾihi wa-li-aḥibbāʾihi dhekr namūd āncheh keh monṣefīn rā nafʿ bakhshad va nejāt dahad. Az bayānāt-e Noqṭeh-ye Ūlā, rūḥ-e mā sevāh fedāh, cheh ʿarabī va cheh fārsī, āncheh dar naẓar būd baʿżī az ān dhekr shod, agarcheh al-yowm Omm al-Bayān mīfarmāyad: Jamīʿ-e Bayān dhekrī ast az Ū va be-radd va qabūl-e Ū moʿallaq va manūṭ.
:::

::: {.translation}
The one God is my witness, and the all-knowing True One bears testimony, that this transient one has sincerely set forth, for His sake and for His chosen ones and His loved ones, what will benefit and save the fair-minded. Some of the utterances of the Primal Point—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—that were in mind, whether Arabic or Persian, have been cited, although today the Mother of Utterance declares: “The whole Bayān is a mention of Him and is dependent upon and subject to His rejection or acceptance.”
:::

### 252

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اگر از فضل حق جل جلاله افق عدل و انصاف از سحاب ظنون و اوهام مقدس شود جمیع شهادت دهند بر آنچه این خادم ذکر نمود چه که کل میدانند نفسی بقدر این عبد از این امر مطلع نبوده ونیست مع ذلک نفوسی که از حقیقت آگاه نبوده‌اند گفته‌اند آنچه را که بعضی از بی خبرهای عالم اخذ نموده و بر طلعت قدم وارد آورده‌اند آنچه را که صخره صیحه زد..... انتهی.
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Agar az fażl-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, ofoq-e ʿadl va enṣāf az saḥāb-e ẓonūn va owhām moqaddas shavad, jamīʿ shahādat dahand bar āncheh īn khādem dhekr namūd, cheh keh koll mīdānand nafsī be-qadr-e īn ʿabd az īn amr moṭṭaleʿ nabūdeh va nīst. Maʿ-e dhālek nofūsī keh az ḥaqīqat āgāh nabūdeh-and gofteh-and āncheh rā keh baʿżī az bī-khabar-hā-ye ʿālam akhdh namūdeh va bar Ṭalʿat-e Qedam vāred āvordeh-and āncheh rā keh ṣakhreh ṣeyḥeh zad..... Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
If, through the grace of the True One—exalted be His glory—the horizon of justice and fairness is cleared of the clouds of conjecture and delusion, all will bear witness to what this servant has stated, for everyone knows that no one has been or is as well informed about this matter as this servant. Nevertheless, people who were unaware of the truth have said things that some of the uninformed in the world have taken up, and they have inflicted upon the Ancient Beauty what has made the rock cry out..... End of quotation.
:::

### 253

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و در لوح ملا علی بجستانی نازل قوله تعالی :
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va dar lawḥ-e Mollā ʿAlī-ye Bajestānī nāzel, qawluhu taʿālā:
:::

::: {.translation}
And in the Tablet to Mullā ʿAlī Bajestānī, this has been revealed—exalted are His words:
:::

### 254

::: {.original lang="fa"}
آنچه از قلم اعلی نازل شد البته ظاهر خواهد گشت سورهٴ رئیس را تلاوت فرمائید و همچنین لوح ملک پاریس را که از اجزای سوره مبارکه هیکل است و همچنین لوح فوأد که مخصوص یکی از احباب نازل شده و این لوح در وقتی نازل شد که پاشا که وزیر خارجه روم بود بمقر خود راجع شده بود و سبب فتنه اخیره و مهاجرت از ارض سرّ بعکا او شده بود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Āncheh az Qalam-e Aʿlā nāzel shod albatteh ẓāher khāhad gasht. Sūreh-ye Raʾīs rā telāvat farmāyīd va hamchenīn Lawḥ-e Malek-e Pārīs rā keh az ajzā-ye Sūreh-ye Mobārakeh-ye Heykal ast, va hamchenīn Lawḥ-e Fuʾād keh makhṣūṣ-e yekī az aḥbāb nāzel shodeh. Va īn lawḥ dar vaqtī nāzel shod keh pāshā keh vazīr-e khārejeh-ye Rūm būd be-maqarr-e khod rājeʿ shodeh būd va sabab-e fetneh-ye akhīreh va mohājerat az Arż-e Serr be-ʿAkkā ū shodeh būd.
:::

::: {.translation}
Whatever has been revealed by the Most Exalted Pen will assuredly come to pass. Read the Sūrih of the Chief, and likewise the Tablet to the King of Paris, which forms part of the blessed Sūrih of the Temple, and also the Tablet of Fuʾād, which was revealed specifically for one of the friends. This Tablet was revealed when the Pasha who was the Ottoman foreign minister had returned to his abode; he had been the cause of the latest upheaval and of the departure from the Land of Mystery to ʿAkkā.
:::

### 255

::: {.original lang="ar"}
دو نفر بودند که بعد از سلطان رئیس کل بودند یکی فؤاد پاشا و یکی عالی پاشا گاهی این صدر اعظم بود و آن وزیر اول خارجه و گاهی بالعکس در آن لوح میفرمایند قوله عزّ کبریائه " سوف نعزل الذی کان مثله و نأخذ امیرهم الذی یحکم علی البلاد و انا العزیز الجبار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Do nafar būdand keh baʿd az solṭān raʾīs-e koll būdand, yekī Fuʾād Pāshā va yekī ʿĀlī Pāshā. Gāhī īn ṣadr-e aʿẓam būd va ān vazīr-e avval-e khārejeh va gāhī be-l-ʿaks. Dar ān lawḥ mīfarmāyand, qawluhu ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu: “Sawfa naʿzilu alladhī kāna mithlahu wa-naʾkhudhu amīrahum alladhī yaḥkumu ʿalā al-bilādi wa-anā al-ʿAzīzu al-Jabbār.”
:::

::: {.translation}
There were two men who, after the Sultan, were the chief authorities: one was Fuʾād Pasha and the other ʿĀlī Pasha. Sometimes the latter was grand vizier and the former chief minister of foreign affairs, and sometimes the reverse. In that Tablet He says—exalted be His majesty: “We will dismiss the one who was like him and seize their ruler who governs the lands, and I am the Almighty, the All-Compelling.”
:::

### 256

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و همچنین در کتاب افدس در نقطه واقعه بین البحرین ملاحظه نمائید که مقصود از آن نقطه اسلامبول است چه که از یک جهتش بحر ابیض است و جهة دیگر بحر اسود باری آنچه از قلم اعلی جاری کل ظاهر شده و اخبارهای دیگر هم که در الواح هست کل ظاهر خواهد شد نشهد انه هو العالم المقتدر السامع البصیر الخبیر....
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va hamchenīn dar Ketāb-e \[corrupted text\] dar noqṭeh-ye vāqeʿeh beyn al-baḥrayn molāḥeẓeh namāyīd keh maqṣūd az ān noqṭeh Eslāmbūl ast, cheh keh az yek jahatash Baḥr-e Abyaż ast va jahat-e dīgar Baḥr-e Asvad. Bārī āncheh az Qalam-e Aʿlā jārī koll ẓāher shodeh va ekhbār-hā-ye dīgar ham keh dar alvāḥ hast koll ẓāher khāhad shod. Nashhadu annahu huwa al-ʿĀlimu al-Muqtadiru al-Sāmiʿu al-Baṣīru al-Khabīr....
:::

::: {.translation}
Likewise, consider in the Book of \[corrupted original text\] the place situated between the two seas. That place means Istanbul, for on one side of it is the White Sea and on the other the Black Sea. In short, everything that has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen has come to pass, and all the other predictions contained in the Tablets will also come to pass. We bear witness that He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing, the All-Aware....
:::
